jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan eerlijke, betrokken en goed presterende teams

Wij geloven dat iedereen een eerlijke kans verdient om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Daarom bouwt Learned software die organisaties helpt met heldere rollen, eerlijke en objectieve beoordelingen, gerichte ontwikkeling en transparante beloning. Dat gebeurt in één doorlopend proces.

Honderden bedrijven, van scale-ups tot corporates, werken al met Learned en dat worden er nog veel meer. Daarom zoeken we versterking in team Product.

Jouw impact als Product Owner

Als Product Owner speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform. Jij zorgt dat onze ambitieuze roadmap niet op papier blijft, maar écht landt. Je vertaalt strategie, klantbehoeften en ideeën naar productverbeteringen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten.

Wat je doet

  • Samen met de Product Lead bepaal je en bewaak je de roadmap. Je kiest ook wat níét gebeurt.

  • Je houdt vier development squads op koers: planning, kwaliteit en voortgang.

  • Je ontwerpt zelf prototypes op basis van prompts en ons design system, en stemt de details zorgvuldig af met UX.

  • Businessbehoeften vertaal je naar scherpe requirements en heldere prioriteiten.

  • Stakeholders houd je aangehaakt bij releases en voortgang.

  • Risico’s en afhankelijkheden zie je aankomen voordat ze een probleem worden.

Jij verbindt strategie, development, design en business, en zorgt dat iedereen dezelfde kant op beweegt: richting de groei van onze klanten.

Wie ben jij?

Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen


Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS

  • Je hebt een 'AI-first' mindset en gebruikt AI (zoals Claude) handig voor het ontwikkelen van prototypes en het opzetten van features.

  • Je hebt meerdere squads tegelijk begeleid in een multidisciplinaire omgeving met development, design en business

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en durft nee te zeggen als het product daar beter van wordt

  • Je werkt vanzelfsprekend agile (Scrum of Kanban) en kent tools als Jira of Productboard

  • Je beslist op basis van data en klantinzichten, niet op onderbuikgevoel

  • Je woont in of rondom Utrecht en werkt minimaal 3 dagen per week op ons kantoor

Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring)

  • Een duidelijk groeipad naar Senior Product Owner

  • Bij contractverlening de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een aandelenregeling

  • Een MacBook en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen

  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis

  • Reiskostenvergoeding

  • Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day: 10%, waarvan wij 50% bijdragen

  • Een jaarlijks persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 (o.b.v. fulltime)

  • Een ambitieuze, internationale werkomgeving (meer dan 7 culturen!) waar we elkaar scherp houden én successen vieren

Uiteindelijk komen we maar op één manier erachter of het klikt? Solliciteer snel en dan drinken we een (digitale) kop koffie!

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

  • You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

  • You are able to work from either our Munich or Nuremberg office at least 3 days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

🎉 CONROO Time Off: Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special milestones like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect – away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process:

  1. Application review

  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and Head of Product & Engineering, Alex, at one of our offices.

  4. Raise the bar in a 60-minute interview with our CEO, Felix

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

jobs.title: Product Manager PRINCE2
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development:

  • Custom onboarding plan per role

  • Internal and external group training

  • Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events:

  • Annual seminars: a global seminar in France and a teaminar in your country

  • Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc.

  • Group activities: weekly yoga classes, monthly karaoke sessions, an indoor rock-climbing group, and participation in solidarity walks

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work:

  • 2-3 days in-office per week

  • Up to €500 reimbursed for remote work equipment

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT in 2026, with one taken for Solidarity Day

🍴 Meal vouchers (Tickets restaurants): Swile card with about 220€ per month

👀 Social & Economic Committee (Comité d’entreprise): Enjoy several benefits with HelloCSE

👩‍⚕️Health:

  • Health insurance (mutuelle) with Alan covered at 50% and available from your first day. You can extend coverage to your partner and children

  • Osteopathy sessions at the office, largely covered by UpSlide

🚆 Commute: Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • Flexible return to work options

  • Help for parents with children up to 6 years old: Either 4 days of fully paid sick-child leave, or, up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

🌳 Sustainability engagements:

  • Certified B-Corp since 2022, which means we not only care about profit, but also about people and the planet

  • Our founders pledged to invest 10 million euros in social and environmental solutions

  • Volunteer days: A paid working day where UpSliders volunteer to a charitable cause

  • Annual veggie lunch: A catered lunch with plant-based foods to raise awareness on the environmental impact of meat consumption and highlight a sustainable alternative

More about UpSlide

  • On top of exciting business challenges in a fast-growing market, you will find a friendly, caring, and challenging culture

  • You will be met with opportunities to acquire new skills, learn from others in a multicultural environment, and grow as a person

  • UpSlide employees have committed to making a positive impact on the world. We obtained B Corp certification in 2022 with strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. UpSlide is now 30% owned by employees. More info here: upslide.net/en/from-a-to-b-corp-our-mission-for-positive-impact/

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you've joined UpSlide ✨

jobs.title: Product Manager - Energy Billing (Fluent French & English)
jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager (Billing)
Location: Paris— 3 days in office (occasional travel to Belgium required) 
Team: Product Management - Billing & Payments
Reporting to: Head of Product

This role is based in London, UK and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to London. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. 

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Please submit your profile in English. 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Lead the localisation efforts for our global energy billing platform, ensuring it meets the specific regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of France, from meter read to bill.
You'll be in charge of the French localisation of the Billing Module—one of the core product domains at the heart of the Kaluza platform. The Billing module processes consumption, pricing, and account data to schedule, calculate, and generate accurate, timely, and compliant invoices throughout a customer’s lifecycle. The module automatically manages billing cycles, generates bills, handles corrections, and produces the data that feeds invoices, billing-related communications, payment schedules, and downstream financial reporting, while powering customer and agent UIs.

This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing  journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients.

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap.

  • Deep dive into French energy market regulations, translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system.

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting).

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys.

  • Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle

Location: Location: Paris, France — 3 days a week in office

Team: Product Management

Reporting To: Group Product Manager

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to

relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza reimagines energy to bring net-zero within everyone’s reach. Our intelligent platform enables energy utilities to unlock the full value of a radically changing energy system and propel us to a future where renewable energy is sustainable, affordable and accessible for all.

From automating and simplifying core operations including billing to create a lower-cost, higher-engagement experience, to optimising energy usage across smart devices in the home, we turn tough challenges into win-win-win outcomes for customers, suppliers and the energy system.

At Kaluza we embrace a flexible, hybrid work model that balances autonomy with the power of in-person connection. Many of our teams find value in coming together regularly to collaborate, strengthen relationships, and accelerate progress. We’re focused on shaping thoughtful, team-driven approaches that support both business impact and individual well-being.

We also prioritise meaningful company-wide gatherings like our annual conference and end-of-year celebrations, that bring us together to align, connect, and celebrate.

What will I be doing?

You will work closely with a team of software engineers on the Belgian expansion of our Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) domain, one of the core product domains of the Kaluza platform. It holds customer, account and contract information and owns the customer journeys around them (for example, moving home or changing contract). It is a full-stack domain: a front end for customer service agents, APIs that expose the data, and back-end services that own the databases and workflow logic. You will therefore work across the whole product domain. This is not a product owner role: you will own features end to end, from dialogue with clients and users to delivery of the software, while running the team’s day-to-day and the discovery work.

Occasional trips to Belgium are possible (around two per quarter).

  • Translate Belgian market requirements into clear specifications — turn the rules of the Belgian energy market into product requirements

  • Become the client’s trusted partner: — work hand in hand with ENGIE and future clients in the Belgian market to understand their needs, run discovery workshops to define how the product works and scope the work, shape requirements together, and build a relationship where they come to you first. That closeness helps you steer what CAL builds next.

  • Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, explore API schemas, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.

  • Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with a full stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in software companies, with a track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.

  • A builder's mentality — resourceful and hands-on, comfortable building a working prototype rather than waiting for the perfect specification.

  • Technically comfortable — at ease with data and data models, databases, and APIs, and able to prototype with modern AI tooling. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one and can hold your own in a technical conversation. Equally happy reasoning about a data model and about what the end user sees on screen.

  • A clear, sharp communicator — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.

  • Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams — engineering, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery etc — to deliver localised solutions.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + 1 birthday day off + bank holidays + RTT days (11), Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Read more about our values over on our careers site.

 

 

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 7000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

🚀Job description

To support our scale, we are looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to join the People team. Reporting into our Lead HRBP, you will contribute at both hands-on and strategic levels, as a trusted partner to our teams and as a program manager to cultivate and develop a best-in-class employee experience.You act as a partner to our People team. You have strong decision-making skills with a thorough understanding of talent management and also organizational design within technology companies, to support our teams’ rapid growth. The HRBP will be responsible for supporting and executing all the projects and functions that will be designed by the HR Development Manager.

Your role will comprise of

HR Business Partnering
- You set up rituals with managers and team members to build relationships of trust and become the preferred contact for the teams.
- With a deep understanding of the population you support, you are the privileged HR point of contact to accompany teams at all steps of the employee life cycle (on-boarding, 3-month and 6-month feedback, performance assessment, compensation review, internal transfer, off-boarding…).
- You advise our people managers on organization design, individual performance review, promotions, compensation.
- You also advise our employees on learning & development opportunities, career pathing and evolution.
- You are the internal communication relay of your perimeter, you ensure a good respect of the rules in force in the company, and you contribute to the animation of new HR processes and of the company's culture in order to maximize retention.

Talent development
- You participate and establish projects related to the People team roadmap
- You will build and run rigorous data analysis and reporting solutions based on business needs, to inform on program or process impact measurements

The profile we are looking for :
- You have a strong experience in a similar position ; having worked in a fast-growing environment is a strong plus
- You have a well-rounded experience on a variety of HR-related topics: onboarding, learning & development, legal, compensation & benefits.
- You excel at creating trust and developing strong working relationships at all levels of an organization
- You demonstrate excellent writing and conversational communications skills in both French and English
- You know how to drive performance management in a fast growing company (+500 hires / year)
- You know how to drive and support your internal stakeholders in projects like designing organisations and anticipating future needs and stakes

- Interview with Charlène, Lead HRBP (45 min - 1h)

- Last round with Salomé (Lead Development) & Comex Member (30 min) + Fit interview with one or two team members (30 min)

jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL)

Lieu: Location: Paris, France — (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)

Team: Product Management

Contrat: CDI

Reporting To: Group Product Manager

Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d’ingénieurs logiciels sur l’expansion belge de notre domaine Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL), l’un des domaines produit centraux de la plateforme Kaluza. Il gère les informations sur les clients, les comptes et les contrats, et porte les parcours client associés (par exemple un déménagement ou un changement de contrat). C’est un domaine full stack : une interface pour les conseillers du service client, des API qui exposent les données et des services backend qui portent les bases de données et la logique de workflow. Vous travaillez donc sur l’ensemble du domaine produit. Ce n’est pas un poste de product owner : vous portez des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du dialogue avec les clients et les utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison du logiciel, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe et la discovery.

Des déplacements ponctuels en Belgique sont possibles (environ deux par trimestre).

  • Traduire les exigences du marché belge en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché belge de l’énergie en exigences produit précises.

  • Devenir le partenaire de confiance du client : travailler main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché belge pour comprendre leurs besoins, mener la discovery en ateliers afin de définir comment le produit fonctionne et de cadrer le périmètre, construire les exigences ensemble et bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vers vous en premier. Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite.

  • Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

  • Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez

Idéalement, vous avez ou vous êtes :

  • Une expérience avérée de Product Manager, de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux.

  • Un français courant et un anglais professionel : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, et vous passez facilement de l’une à l’autre langue.

  • De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués.

  • Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données et les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous savez prototyper avec les outils d’IA modernes. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran.

  • Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées.

  • La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + 1 jour pour votre anniversaire + jours fériés + jours de RTT (11), congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre careers page et sur LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible here.

jobs.description:
Hier bewegst du ganze Branchen: Steuere mit uns die größten digitalen und geschäftlichen Transformationsprojekte überhaupt. Unsere SAP Expertise reicht über die verschiedensten Industrien:

  • Products: Pharma & Life Sciences, Automotive, Consumer Goods & Services, Retail, Travel & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense and Industrial Manufacturing
  • Resources: Chemie & Energieversorgung
  • Financial Services: Banking, Capital Markets und Versicherung
  • Telekommunikation, Medien & High Tech
  • Public Services: Öffentliche Verwaltung

Deine Mission

Als SAP Delivery Lead übernimmst du eine führende Rolle bei der Unterstützung von Topkonzernen mit bedeutendem Vertragsvolumen bei der Modernisierung ihrer SAP-Systeme, um zur digitalen Transformation beizutragen. Du fokussierst dich dabei auf moderne, cloud-basierte Applikationsarchitekturen mit SAP S/4 Hana als Grundlage und verantwortest die Leitung sowie Überwachung von SAP-Projekten, um sicherzustellen, dass diese termingerecht, im Kostenplan und gemäß den Kundenerwartungen geliefert werden.

Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen. Diese Position ist in Voll- und Teilzeit möglich.

Aufgaben

  • Leite die digitale Transformation in verschiedenen Branchen. Financial Services, Telekommunikation, Medien & High Tech, Resources, Products und Public Services: Setze Digitalstrategien in diversen Branchen um. Deine Aufgaben als Führungskraft sind so anspruchsvoll wie vielfältig – genau wie deine Kunden: End-to-end, über alle Funktionen und Technologien hinweg treibst du das große Ganze voran.
  • Berate nationale und internationale Top-Unternehmen. Als SAP Delivery Lead zeigst du dem Vorstand deiner Kunden, welche Geschäftschancen sich durch flexiblere IT-Liefermodelle, eine modernere IT-Infrastruktur und innovative (Cloud-)Technologien nutzen lassen. Wir stehen am Markt für „Delivery Excellence“ und du stellst sicher, dass wir diesem Ruf weiterhin gerecht werden.
  • Stärke deine Projekte mit maßgeschneiderten Kompetenzen: In deiner Rolle holst du dir genau die Fähigkeiten, die du für deine Projekte brauchst. Dazu greifst du auf Expert:innen aus allen Business Units von Accenture zurück, nutzt unsere global agierenden Centers of Excellence und bindest bei Bedarf auch Technologie-Partner aus unserem Allianz-Netzwerk ein.

Qualifikation

  • Ca. 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung von großen SAP- Projekten; gerne auch in Rollen als Projekt- oder Programmleiter
  • Erfahrung in der Definition von S/4 Hana basierten Roadmaps hin zu modernen und cloud-basierten Applikationsarchitekturen
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit agilen Projektmethoden
  • Starke Führungs- und Konfliktlösungskompetenz
  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch sowie in Englisch

Benefits

  • Eine Arbeitskultur, die Diversität und Inklusion fördert
  • Attraktive Aufstiegschancen
  • Lohnenswerte Corporate-Angebote, beispielsweise für Versicherungen und Altersvorsorge

Selbst wenn Du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst: Zögere nicht, Dich zu bewerben! Wir arbeiten gemeinsam an Lösungen.

Du und Accenture

In dieser Rolle bist du Teil der SAP Business Group von Accenture Technology. Wir kombinieren People, SAP-Technologie und Industry Excellence, um innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln, die den Weg zu nachhaltigem Wachstum beschleunigen.

Von #Customer Experience bis #Financials, von #Process Transformation bis #Source-to-pay.

Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.​

jobs.title: Product Manager (12 month FTC)
Product Manager Fabrics
Director, Technical Product Marketing
jobs.description:
• Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads.

  • Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software for customers with demanding AI requirements.

  • As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions to provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant.

About the Role

Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing with deep, hands-on knowledge of AI infrastructure, GPU compute and datacenters to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.

The role in brief

  • An embedded role, close to the product, close to engineering, and close to what we are building: end-to-end datacenters purpose-built for large-scale GPU compute and AI model training and inference.

  • You will spend time with infrastructure, datacenter design and operations, product, engineering, solutions, partnerships and the leadership team.

  • You will extract the technical truth from the building (power and cooling design, GPU cluster architecture, networking fabric, how customers train and serve models) and identify what is differentiated.

  • You will turn that into blogs, web pages, whitepapers, case studies, executive thought leadership, speaking narratives and product storytelling.

What this role is not

  • Not a conventional PMM role centred only on launch checklists, personas and sales decks. Our audience is hyperfocused and well understood.

  • Not a technical writing role.

The right person

  • Technically curious, commercially sharp, and an exceptional writer.

  • Deeply technical in data centers / AI factories and AI infrastructure.

  • Understands GPU and accelerator architectures, how frontier models are trained and served, and what those workloads demand of power, cooling, networking and physical design.

  • Knows how to sit with engineers, ask good questions, pressure-test claims, and translate complex infrastructure into language that is accurate, compelling and useful.

What You'll Do

Technical Product Narrative

  • Own Radiant's technical product narrative across our GPU platform, infrastructure, datacenter footprint and market-facing offerings.

  • Work with product and engineering to understand what we build, how it works, what problems it solves and why it is different, from site, power and thermal design through to GPU cluster performance and model workload efficiency.

  • Translate that into positioning, messaging, product explanations and technical narratives for customers, partners, analysts, executives and the broader market.

  • The questions you'll be asking:

    • Why did we build this this way?

    • What breaks at scale: power density, liquid cooling, GPU interconnect, cluster utilisation?

    • What tradeoff did we avoid?

    • What is genuinely differentiated, and what is defensible?

    • What should a technical buyer, such as a model builder or hyperscaler infrastructure lead, care about?

Technical Content & Thought Leadership

  • Create the core technical content that gives hyperscaler and AI lab customers confidence that Radiant is who they should trust to run their most demanding GPU workloads.

  • Formats include:

    • Technical blog posts, product pages and solution pages

    • Whitepapers and reference architecture content (GPU cluster design, high-density rack deployments, liquid cooling, power architecture)

    • Case studies and customer stories

    • Launch narratives and technical explainers

    • Executive essays and long-form thought leadership

  • Make complex topics understandable without making them simplistic.

  • Write for technical buyers, ML and infrastructure engineers, datacenter engineers, business decision-makers, partners, investors and industry observers, adjusting the level of detail without losing credibility.

Web & Product Copy

  • Help shape the language on Radiant's website and product pages.

  • Turn internal product reality into strong external copy that covers:

    • What the product does and who it is for

    • Why it matters and how it is different

    • The proof points that support the claim (GPU performance, power efficiency, capacity, deployment speed)

  • Work with design, web, product and marketing teams to create pages that are clear, technically grounded and commercially useful.

Speaking & Executive Substance

  • Create the technical spine behind talks, panels, submissions, keynotes, podcasts, executive posts and strategic narratives across the AI and datacenter industry calendar.

  • The social and communications team may own the opportunity pipeline and distribution cadence. You provide the substance: the thesis, the architecture, the proof points, the technical argument, the story arc and the language.

  • Ghostwrite for corporate and executive voices where content needs technical depth, product understanding or strategic market framing, on topics such as GPU generations, AI compute supply, power availability and model scaling.

  • Be public-facing yourself: an excellent communicator with a credible presence in the datacenter and AI infrastructure community, able to hold your own on stage and in a room of engineers and AI researchers.

Case Studies, Customer Stories & Proof Points

  • Build Radiant's library of customer, partner and product proof.

  • Work with sales, solutions, customer teams, GPU and hardware partners, and leadership to identify strong stories.

  • Turn them into case studies, web copy, blogs, presentations and sales-supporting narratives.

  • Find the real story behind each account:

    • What problem existed

    • What was deployed (compute, cooling, power, network)

    • What changed for the customer's models and workloads

    • What was hard, what mattered, and what the market should learn from it

Internal Translation

  • Act as a bridge between engineering, datacenter operations, product, sales, marketing and leadership.

  • Engineers should trust you because you ask good questions and represent the technology accurately, down to the GPU, the rack and the megawatt.

  • Marketing should trust you because you can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling language.

  • Sales should trust you because your work helps customers understand why Radiant matters.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days

  • Strong working relationships built with product and engineering.

  • A clear understanding of Radiant's technical architecture, GPU platform, datacenter design and product priorities.

  • A meaningful set of market-facing assets shipped.

  • A repeatable process for extracting technical stories from the organisation and turning them into blogs, web copy, technical narratives, executive content, speaking inputs and longer-form assets.

Over time

  • Radiant has a deeper, sharper, more technically credible voice and is recognised as a leading voice in AI infrastructure and datacenters.

  • The website explains the product more clearly.

  • Our blogs are technical, differentiated, and read by the people who build and run AI at scale.

Who You Are

Experience and technical depth

  • 8–12+ years in technical product marketing, product marketing, technical content, developer marketing, infrastructure marketing, solutions marketing or a closely related role, with a substantial part of that in AI infrastructure, GPU compute or datacenters.

  • A background in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, datacenters or high-performance computing.

  • Deep technical AI experience (essential): you understand how GPUs and accelerators work, how models are trained and served, and how those workloads drive compute, networking, power and cooling design. A technical degree is preferred.

  • You know datacenters from the inside: power density, liquid and air cooling, electrical and mechanical design, capacity planning and build-out, with a visible presence or network in the datacenter community.

  • Technically fluent enough to work directly with product managers, engineers, architects, ML practitioners, datacenter engineers and technical executives. You don't need to be an engineer, but you understand complex systems, from GPU interconnects and cluster topology to the power and thermal envelope of a hall.

  • You keep up with the market: GPU roadmaps, model releases and datacenter developments, and you can explain what each new generation means for infrastructure.

Writing and judgment

  • An excellent writer who can produce product pages, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, executive essays, launch narratives and technical explainers on GPU infrastructure, AI models and datacenter design with minimal handholding.

  • Strong product judgment: you can distinguish a feature from a benefit, a claim from a proof point, a capability from a differentiated position, and a generic AI market trend from a useful point of view.

  • Strong editorial taste: you know when copy is too generic, too inflated, too shallow or too complicated, and can make technical content sharper without making it flashy or imprecise.

Ways of working

  • Comfortable working in the building: regular face time with product, engineering and leadership is part of the job, as is time on site in our datacenters.

  • Highly autonomous: you don't wait for perfect briefs. You find the right people, ask the right questions, create the draft, pressure-test the claims and move the work forward.

  • Commercially aware: you understand that technical marketing exists to help the market understand the company, help customers evaluate the product, help sales tell the story, help executives communicate clearly, and help the company build credibility in a highly competitive AI infrastructure market.

Ideal Background

  • Where you've worked: high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, GPU cloud / neocloud providers, hyperscale and colocation datacenter operators, AI model companies, cloud platforms, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems (particularly GPU and accelerator vendors), or technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

  • Strongly preferred: experience working with engineers, architects, ML researchers, datacenter design teams, product leaders, founders or technical executives.

  • Required: experience writing about complex technical topics for external audiences, specifically on GPU compute, AI models and datacenter infrastructure.

  • Strong advantage: a track record of speaking, publishing or being visibly active in the AI infrastructure or datacenter community.

To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.
