jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on.

ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with.

What the job involves

Roadmap ownership

  • Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan.

  • Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning.

  • Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked.

  • Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions.

Discovery and definition

  • Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs.

  • Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility.

  • Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve.

Product operations and delivery

  • Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow.

  • Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments.

  • Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan.

Technical and data judgement

  • Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics.

  • Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders.

  • Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction.

Research, validation and data

  • Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it.

  • Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want.

  • Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users.

  • Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design.

  • For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off.

  • Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation.

Working with AI: Co-Analyst

  • Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need.

  • Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses.

  • Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations.

Raising the bar for product practice

  • Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use.

  • Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas.

  • Act as a coaching and advisory resource for colleagues, sharing product craft across teams and mentoring less experienced team members as the function grows.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, machine learning, design, customer success, and research within your product areas, ensuring cohesive development cycles and smooth delivery.

  • Partner closely with the design team on design and UX, engineering on build and AI/ML, and the research and analysis team on domain expertise, synthesising their input into coherent product decisions.

  • Facilitate cross-team workshops to bring evidence and expertise together, and strengthen pre-sprint and in-sprint communication.

You should apply if

  • You have shipped complex products in technical domains, ideally AI/ML, data, or intelligence, and you do your best work owning a product area end to end: from opportunity definition to shipped customer value.

  • You are as comfortable in the detail as in the plan. Writing a PRD, interrogating usage data, or pressure-testing a model integration with engineers is the core of your craft, not a chore.

  • You hold evidence and conviction in balance. You know when user research should lead and when expertise-led judgement should, and you can make and defend either call.

  • You do your best work in a founder-led, vision-led company. You know the difference between owning a vision and making a vision real, and the second is the work you enjoy. The pace and ambiguity of a growth-stage company is what you are looking for rather than what you are tolerating.

  • You find genuine satisfaction in bringing order to messy tooling and processes, because you have seen how much leverage a well-run product operation creates.

  • You make the people around you better. You share your craft, coach colleagues, and improve the processes you work within, without needing a title that says you must.

Where this role can take you

  • Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means broader ownership, higher-stakes bets, and more direct influence over product strategy.

  • Help define how AI-native intelligence products get built. Co-Analyst is a category-shaping product, and the work you deliver will influence how the industry approaches human-AI analytical workflows.

  • Grow with the Product function. As ExTrac scales, this role is the natural path towards senior product leadership. Progress on either track: ExTrac values the individual contributor and Manager paths equally, so you can deepen technical scope or take on people leadership as your responsibilities grow.

Requirements

  • ExTrac provides services to a number of government clients, some of which specify nationality criteria for individuals seeking security clearance. For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand.

  • 4+ years in product management, ideally in AI/ML, data science, or intelligence-related fields, with a proven track record of shipping complex products from concept through to delivery.

  • Experience delivering product work in a startup or growth-stage company, with demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end with minimal oversight.

  • Able to translate complex technical solutions into product decisions, judging when user research should lead (usability and workflow fit) and when expertise-led conviction should (what to build), and using data and analytics as inputs rather than the whole answer.

  • Comfortable working hand in hand with engineering and ML teams, with a good understanding of how complex ML models are integrated into user-facing products, alongside data processing and analytics.

  • Skilled at working with engineering, ML, design, and customer success, and at synthesising input from multiple disciplines into coherent product decisions in a collaborative, agile environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex information clearly to executives, clients, and internal teams.

Desirable

  • Experience in threat intelligence, risk analysis, or geopolitical intelligence, or in other highly regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g. government, defence).

  • Experience working within complex, data-led startups or other high-growth digital environments.

  • A foundation in machine learning, data analytics, or AI product management, particularly integrating complex ML models into user-facing products.

Interview Process

We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Initial Intro Interview - 30 Minutes

  • Craft & Competency-based Interviews - 60 Minutes x 2

  • Senior Executive Interview - 45 Minutes


Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • A sabbatical leave offer.

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office.

  • A role that combines mission-driven purpose with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing company.


ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

  • Tu vérifies que les données existent et qu’elles sont exploitables avant de lancer un cas d’usage

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec les data engineers et les data scientists, et tu sais lire et interpréter la donnée par toi-même

Le volet IA

  • Tu pilotes des produits IA : assistants, agents, recherche sur la documentation interne (RAG), modèles de prévision

  • Tu fais équipe avec nos AI Engineers : tu comprends leurs contraintes et tu challenges leurs choix quand il faut

  • Tu suis la performance des modèles et surtout leur adoption réelle par les utilisateurs

  • Tu aides les métiers à comprendre ce que l’IA peut faire pour eux, et ce qu’elle ne fera pas

Avec l’expérience, tu prends des sujets plus structurants, comme la stratégie produit, la gouvernance de la donnée ou le passage à l’échelle d’un pilote IA, et tu accompagnes les PM plus juniors.

🧭 Ton évolution

Chez nous, ce sont tes résultats en mission qui font avancer ta carrière, jusqu’à un rôle de Lead si tu en as envie. Comme Hubvisory a aussi une practice d’AI Engineers et une practice Orga & Transfo, tu peux élargir ton périmètre sans changer d’entreprise.

💡 Pourquoi Hubvisory

  • On fait du Product et de l’IA depuis 2016, et rien d’autre

  • Tu interviens chez Dior, Decathlon, Leroy Merlin, France TV…

  • Tu te formes régulièrement sur des sujets qui te passionnent, comme l’IA générative, la data, le design ou la stratégie produit, et chaque mois les Hub’times te permettent d’apprendre de ce que les autres consultants vivent en mission

  • Ton salaire est revu deux fois par an, et jusqu’à 22 % des profits sont redistribués en intéressement, à parts égales

💰 Salaire : de 46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel selon ton expérience, plus l’intéressement et les primes (commerciale, ancienneté sur mission, cooptation).


👤 Ton profil

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience comme PM ou PO

  • Les bases du métier sont solides : discovery, roadmap, priorisation, backlog, user stories, agile (Scrum, Kanban), outils comme Jira ou Confluence

  • Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit data (API, datalake, data platform, BI) ou sur un produit IA (machine learning, IA générative, agents). Si tu connais un seul des deux volets, on t’aide à monter en compétences sur l’autre

  • Tu ne codes pas forcément au quotidien, mais une requête SQL ou une architecture RAG ne te font pas peur

  • Tu parles anglais dans un cadre professionnel

  • Tu fais de la veille sans qu’on te le demande. On te demandera sûrement ta dernière découverte IA en entretien 😉

🔄 Le process

  1. Un court appel de pré-qualification (15 min)

  2. Un échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition sur ton projet (1h)

  3. Un cas pratique avec un consultant Data & IA (1h30)

  4. Un entretien avec un des fondateurs (1h30)

  5. Un dernier appel pour la proposition

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Technical
Fullstack DevOps Engineer (Trust and Identity)
jobs.description:
Fullstack DevOps Engineer

In a technically exciting and fast-evolving environment, you will help us build digital trust products for organizations. Our team enables the use of verifiable information in business processes: eID, verifiable credentials, organization identity, KYB, digital signatures, PDF validation, trust chains, and secure onboarding flows.

Many trust, verification, and compliance processes are still manual, fragmented, and costly. We want to change that by building simple, secure, and easy-to-integrate products that allow organizations to verify information, trace it back to an authentic source, and create better user experiences for their customers and partners.

As a Fullstack DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and selected frontend capabilities for these products. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, UX specialists, and ecosystem partners to turn complex trust and compliance topics into reliable production services.

What impact will you have?

  • Build and operate backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot.

  • Design secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for eID, verification, onboarding, KYB, and compliance-related products.

  • Work with AWS services, databases, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure automation.

  • Model and manage data across relational and/or NoSQL databases with a focus on reliability, traceability, and performance.

  • Integrate frontend applications with robust APIs, authentication, authorization, and secure data flows.

  • Contribute to frontend features where needed using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

  • Take end-to-end DevOps ownership: from implementation and automated testing to deployment, monitoring, incident handling, and continuous improvement.

  • Help the team build market-driven products that create real value, not just technical functionality.


Must-haves:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience.

  • 5 years of professional experience in backend or fullstack software engineering.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and/or Kotlin.

  • Solid experience building services with Spring Boot.

  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and distributed backend systems.

  • Practical experience with AWS cloud services.

  • Good knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, and query performance.

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, Git-based workflows, and production operations.

  • Basic frontend experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular.

  • Ability to work in an agile, international, and cross-functional DevOps team.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with identity, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, OIDC, eID, digital signatures, onboarding, compliance, or regulated B2B products.

  • Knowledge of verifiable credentials, wallets, trust chains, PKI, certificates, or related digital trust concepts.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, queues, or asynchronous processing.

  • Experience with observability tooling, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

  • Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, accessibility, or component libraries.

  • Strong communication skills, pragmatic thinking, and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Want to know more about the team?

We build products that help organizations use trustworthy and verifiable information in digital processes. Our work focuses on reducing manual verification, improving compliance workflows, and creating secure infrastructure that can be integrated into real business use cases.

You will join a team working on emerging digital trust topics across Switzerland and Europe, including eID, organizational identity, verifiable credentials, Know Your Business processes, digital signatures, PDF validation, and secure onboarding.

We work closely with the market, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to build products that solve concrete problems for organizations.


Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are spark passion, aim high and stand true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance

  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth

  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!

  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office

  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family

  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance

  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance

  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms

  • Travel allowance reimbursement

  • 500 euros home office allowance

  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

  • Salary range: 60,000 to 65,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

  • Work from abroad possibility for one month per year

  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves

  • 25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

  • To begin with you will receive a fixed term contract (one year), after 6 months of your employment with us, after a feedback meeting with the team, there is a possibility of extending the contract 

  • The salary ranges mentioned in our Job Descriptions are base annual gross salaries including the 8% holiday allowance

jobs.description:
About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

(Senior) Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Als Project Manager bist du die zentrale Kraft hinter der Umsetzung cross-funktionaler Projekte bei Statista R und stellst sicher, dass Initiativen zuverlässig und zielorientiert ins Ziel gebracht werden.

 

Deine Rolle

  • Steuerung und Umsetzung cross-funktionaler Projekte und operativer Initiativen mit klarem Fokus auf Ergebnisse und Verbindlichkeit

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von PMO-Strukturen, die Verantwortlichkeiten und Fortschritte transparent machen

  • Einfordern von klaren Zusagen und konsequentes Nachhalten von Meilensteinen, um eine verlässliche Umsetzungskultur zu etablieren

  • Proaktive Kommunikation und Alignment zwischen Teams und Management durch strukturierte Updates und Statusberichte

  • Inhaltliche Vorbereitung von Entscheidungsvorlagen, Strukturierung komplexer Themen und Sparring mit dem Lead

  • Eigenständige Übernahme operativer Themen neben der Projektsteuerung

 

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in einem PMO, Transformation Office oder in der strategischen Unternehmensberatung (Strategy/Operations)

  • Klare und direkte Kommunikation, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, auf allen Ebenen souverän und überzeugend aufzutreten

  • Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen mit unterschiedlichen Interessen und Prioritäten

  • Analytisches und strategisches Denkvermögen kombiniert mit hohem Umsetzungstempo

  • Technisches Grundverständnis und hohe Affinität zu datengetriebener Arbeit

  • Erfahrung in der parallelen Steuerung mehrerer Projekte unterschiedlicher Komplexität

  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, Verbindlichkeit in Projektstrukturen zu verankern

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und unserem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu stärken, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von:

  • Arbeiten im Ausland bis zu 30 Kalendertage im Jahr

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und Gleitzeit

  • Internationales Team und soziale Events

  • Bezuschusste urbane Mobilität sowie Zugang zu Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten

  • Kostenloser Zugang zu Langdock und all seinen tollen Funktionen

  • Karriere- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About the Product Team

You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.

 

The Role

As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.

You’ll own several products across Rivia’s platform. This requires holistic understanding of market and customer needs for complex prioritisation decisions. To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.

 

What Excites You

  • Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

  • Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

  • Defining product management foundation, from first principles, as the first product hire.

  • Joining a team that already works AI-native: agentic features run in production on live trials, customers connect their own agents through the Rivia MCP, and much of the roadmap ahead is AI products. You work the same way, from AI-built mockups to agent-driven analysis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Product Execution: Own the full product lifecycle for your scope: discovery, spec, delivery, and post-launch measurement.

  • Drive Cross-Team Coordination: Align Engineering, Design,w and Clinical stakeholders to hit delivery deadlines. Work closely with GTM to synchronize assets and commercial readiness with each release.

  • Channel Customers need: Run structured feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring their needs are prioritised and our products are usable, reliable and high quality.

  • Oversee a Multi-Product Portfolio: Weigh competing priorities across the product line, deliberately direct your own attention and your teams' bandwidth, and make sure customers experience the products as one coherent whole.

  • Own Product performance: Set KPIs and targets before building, measure feature health after launch, and make kill, iterate, or double-down calls on the data.

  • AI-Powered Product Development: Use AI agents in your daily work, including AI-generated mockups to accelerate discovery, and identify where AI unlocks new value for clinical teams.

  • Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

 

What Excites Us

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS with technical products

  • You have been the first or sole PM at a B2B startup and built the product function around an engineer-led team

  • Has taken at least one product from idea to production with demonstrable adoption

  • Hands-on product analytics: built measurement from zero with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Has designed and run product processes (refinement, discovery, launches) that engineering teams actually kept

  • AI-native way of working: uses AI agents in daily product work, with concrete examples

  • Comfortable being the only product person: self-directed, builds the function while running it

  • Clinical trials, drug development, or health data experience is a strong plus. Exceptional PMs without it are welcome.

Bonus

  • Former lead or head of product who wants to build hands-on again

  • Experience shipping for expert or scientific users

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

  • Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analist / Product Owner E-health
jobs.description:
Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

  • Teamspirit: Versterk de teamgeest door deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals een tennistoernooi of de singelloop in Breda. Bouw samen met je collega's aan een hechter team.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering.

No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments

Responsibilities

  • Lead user and customer research: plan and run qualitative, quantitative and field studies across installation, operation and maintenance (for example alongside our Application Engineers), and translate findings into product and design decisions.

  • Design the user experience of our software platform: turn product requirements from Product Management and the Product Owner into information architecture, user flows and interaction patterns for complex, data-rich operator workflows (detect, assess, identify and classify), from early concepts to interactive prototypes.

  • Propose and hand over UI designs to front-end developers: create high-fidelity, build-ready designs and specifications, align on feasibility with developers and the Product Owner, and review implementations for quality and consistency.

  • Own end-to-end customer journeys: map the experience from in-field deployment and data acquisition through data processing to the software platform, including demo flows and supporting internal processes.

  • Manage personas and customer insights: maintain the persona set and a central research repository, and synthesise learnings collected across the organisation.

  • Validate and measure outcomes: run usability tests before and after release, define adoption and usability metrics, and report impact to stakeholders.

  • Evolve and maintain our design system: extend the existing basis with UI components, patterns and guidelines that keep the platform consistent, accessible and efficient to develop.

  • Partner across the organisation: work closely with Product Management, Product Ownership and System Architecture, as well as Sales, Business Development, Application Engineering, Support and Marketing, to prioritise development, reduce product risk and advance user-centred practices.


Requirements

  • Master’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in UX or product design, covering both user research and hands-on UX/UI design, preferably in defense or other technical, high-stakes industries.

  • A portfolio showing end-to-end work, from research and workflows to high-fidelity UX/UI for data-rich professional software (e.g. situational-awareness, control-room or analytics applications).

  • Experience working on integrated software platforms rather than isolated websites or prototypes.

  • Experience handing designs over to front-end developers and working with and evolving a design system, with a working understanding of front-end technology and its constraints.

  • Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and design proposals.

  • Understanding of end-to-end systems in which sensor data is acquired in the field, processed and exposed on a software platform, ideally in complex or regulated environments.

  • Able to translate complex technical workflows and data into clear, intuitive interfaces, with strong attention to visual detail, consistency and quality.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; able to present research and designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in Figma and in research and collaboration tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Dovetail and Miro.

  • Willingness to travel and do field research.

  • Driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have

  • Big plus: Experience with underwater acoustics or sonar software.

  • Plus: Experience in design leadership, or in setting up design practices in a growing organisation.

  • Plus: Front-end skills (e.g. HTML/CSS, React) for prototyping next to AI based tooling.

  • Plus: Proficiency in Dutch.


Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines.

 

In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen.

 

Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen.

 

Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het:

  • doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties;

  • bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren;

  • vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen;

  • identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast;

  • bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld;

  • opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang;

  • intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten;

  • bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities;

  • bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling.

 

Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder?

“Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen!

 

Warm en professioneel bad

Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken.

 

Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.”

 

Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.”

 

Wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn;

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements;

  • Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken;

  • Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling;

  • Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants;

  • Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre;

  • Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal;

 

Wij bieden

  • Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

  • Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team;

  • Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s;

  • Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen.

Ben jij dé Senior Product Manager MRP die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan nu en bouw mee aan onze producten! Wil jij eerst meer weten over de functie of Voortman Steel Machinery, neem dan contact op met Guus Regelink via ----- of bel/WhatsApp naar 0626393850. Twijfel je of jouw achtergrond aansluit bij de functie? Laat het dan vooral weten. Er is vaak meer mogelijk dan je denkt!

With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

As a Staff Product Manager on Ledger Wallet, you own a full product domain end to end, for example Earn or Swap/Buy/Sell. You are accountable for its vision, roadmap, adoption and business results.

We are looking for a strong, autonomous PM. You will turn a complex and regulated space into simple, safe experiences that users trust and come back to, and that grow Ledger's revenue.

You lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and a delivery manager, working closely with Data, Business Development, Legal, Compliance, Marketing and external partners.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own your domain's vision and roadmap. Define where the domain goes next and turn it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances growth, platform scalability and user trust.

  • Grow adoption and revenue. Understand your funnel inside out, remove friction, and move the metrics that matter: conversion, retention, volume and revenue.

  • Decide with data. Use Mixpanel and our analytics stack to define KPIs, find drop-offs, run experiments and prioritize on evidence, not opinion.

  • Know your users and market. Stay close to users through research and feedback, and track competitors so Ledger stays the most relevant and safest option.

  • Ship end to end. Write sharp PRDs, take initiatives through our product gates within quarterly planning, and lead your squad from discovery to launch and iteration.

  • Communicate with clarity. Produce decision-ready roadmaps, vision docs and dashboards that leadership and partners can act on without further editing.

  • Work with partners. Evaluate, integrate and manage third-party providers, and shape commercial and rev-share models with Business Development.

  • Navigate regulation with Legal and Compliance. Build products that are compliant by design across markets, and turn constraints into clear product decisions.

  • Shape strategy beyond your domain. Contribute to the Ledger Wallet vision and annual roadmap, and connect your domain to the rest of the product: onboarding, engagement, device and money movement.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Enterprise Success Manager at Mistral, you own what happens to our most strategic enterprise accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows, keep production ARR healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams create high-value AI use cases with our customers. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, measuring its business impact, and scaling value across the organization. You will work with customer sponsors, business teams, IT and security stakeholders, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout, a motion already credited in a major European win.

What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Delivery/Implementation, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical AI or SaaS environment.

  • Experience owning outcomes for enterprise customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premises, VPC, serverless) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and security reviews, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security teams, while translating technical trade-offs into clear business implications for executives and users. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion.

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.

  • Fluent English; professional French strongly preferred (a significant share of our enterprise base is French-speaking).

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Experience building adoption, change-management or customer education programs across large organizations.

  • Experience at a forward-deployed, solutions-led company.

What We Offer

Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
