Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 65-person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries, growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

⚙️ The role

ScorePlay is the platform major sports organizations use to manage, search and share their media, from the second it's captured to the moment it reaches everyone's screen. A photographer uploads thousands of shots after the final whistle. A live feed has to be logged and clipped into highlights while the game is still being played. The right assets have to reach 10,000+ athletes, partners and newsrooms worldwide, automatically. At 145M+ minutes of video ingested every month and 15+ petabytes stored, much of the architecture needed at that scale simply hasn't been built before.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our product engineering teams. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and sit on the engineering leadership team.

This is a technical role. You'll need a deep understanding of how our systems work to prioritize well and propose the right technical solutions. Shipping code isn't your main priority, though. Your main priorities are building the environment that lets your team ship faster, the quality of its technical decisions, the people you grow, and the problems you solve before they become incidents. Understanding how everything works is a must. Shipping code is extra.

🔥 Why this is interesting

This is a rare chance to work where engineering meets sports. You'll help build a unique, state-of-the-art product whose engineering challenges come from data volume and latency. Content has to be ingested, processed, searched and distributed at petabyte scale, often while the match is still being played. When the whistle blows, the platform has to be fast, and it has to hold.

🧠 What you'll own

People

  • Manage and grow your team: regular one-on-ones, clear expectations, direct feedback, growth plans that mean something.

  • Handle performance head-on. Recognize what's great, address what isn't early and in writing, and see it through when it doesn't improve.

  • Hire with our talent acquisition team: define the profiles your team needs, run interviews, and onboard new engineers so they ship in their first weeks.

Technical direction

  • Own the quality of your team's technical decisions: review and challenge designs, requests for comments (RFCs) and estimates.

  • Drive foundational work from problem framing to production, and balance it against client commitments.

  • Own your team's reliability: incidents, debug complex issues, postmortems, on-call health, and technical debt that gets paid down, not just listed.

Product and speed

  • Run your team's delivery with your product manager as one small team that shares context instead of handing it off.

  • Make your team faster, every quarter. Take a feature that took twelve weeks and work out how it could have taken one: cut waste, automate what can be automated, and improve your processes.

  • Define what can be delegated to AI and what needs thorough design and review, and set the guardrails that keep that line clear.

  • Push back when a product decision doesn't hold up technically, and propose what would.

  • Work with clients' technical teams on integrations and enterprise workflows when it matters.

  • Be ready to get your hands dirty and go the extra mile. Sometimes it's all hands on deck, and that means you chip in too (and ship in).

Beyond your team

  • Prioritize topics that go beyond engineering, and work with stakeholders from other teams (product, sales, customer success, support) to move them forward.

  • Contribute to engineering leadership: how we plan, how we run incidents, how we make decisions.

🛠 The stack and how we work

Golang for services. PostgreSQL, Kafka, Temporal for workflows, OpenSearch, Kubernetes, all on AWS. We use AI heavily (but wisely), in the product and in how we work as engineers.

Small cross-functional teams own their scope from conception to production. Structural decisions go through RFCs. Every week, the whole engineering team gets together to present and debate technical subjects. Every incident gets a postmortem, with real numbers attached.

🧩 What we're looking for

  • 3+ years managing engineers as an Engineering Manager, after a solid run as a backend or platform engineer. You've managed underperformance to resolution, not only coached strong performers.

  • A real technical foundation in backend and distributed systems. You don't need to write Go every day, but you can read an RFC on a search index or a Kafka topology and spot what's wrong.

  • You've led a team through a significant architectural change while still delivering for customers.

  • Initiative beyond your scope: examples of problems you owned across teams without being asked.

  • Clear written communication. At ScorePlay, decisions are made in writing.

  • A builder first. You've managed and you understand management in depth, but your instinct is to build and simplify, not to add layers and complexity.

  • You've made a team measurably faster: shorter cycles, fewer hand-offs, more done by fewer people.

  • Bonus: experience in a scale-up with 10–50 engineers, or on video, media or storage-heavy products.

📍 The setup

Remote from Europe, remote-first with regular team gatherings, in an international team spread across Europe and the US.

On-call is part of the role. When our platform is down, matches are happening without us. As an Engineering Manager, you're on the escalation path: when an incident needs coordination, decisions or someone to pull in the right people, that's you. Every incident gets a written postmortem with cost and impact attached, so the same thing doesn't wake anyone up twice.

🏆 Why ScorePlay

  • Real scale, real stakes: 145M+ minutes of video a month, and the systems your team builds now become the foundations for years.

  • The product is technical to its core, and it's what clients pay for. Engineering leaders are in the room for business decisions.

  • No layers, no committees. A short line from you to the Head of Engineering and the founders.

  • Your team's work shows up on match day, used by clubs, leagues and athletes you might already follow.

  • An international team of 15+ nationalities across Europe and the US.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

Compensation: $80K – $110K • $150K Equity

At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port enables our UAV platforms to launch, land, charge and return to mission readiness autonomously.

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for core hardware topics across the Drone Port product. You will guide mechanical development from concept and prototypes through verification and validation, supporting the product lifecycle through series readiness and customer demonstrations.

You will work very closely with Electrical Engineering, Embedded Software, Systems Engineering, Testing, Manufacturing, Procurement and external development partners and suppliers. Your work will help deliver reliable, available and manufacturable mechanical hardware for current and future Drone Port generations.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Act as the technical point of contact for key hardware topics across the Drone Port product like housing, frame and opening mechanism

  • Develop and assess mechanical concepts for future Drone Port generations, and support architecture and design decisions.

  • Guide the mechanic development lifecycle from concept through prototypes, technical verification and system validation.

  • Contribute to PCB, wiring harness and system designs with internal teams and external development partners.

  • Plan, build and commission prototypes, and support integration, testing and customer demonstrations.

  • Provide technical leadership to the hardware and electronics development team, and technical support to the Drone Port Testing team.

  • Take ownership of agreed decisions and represent the Team Lead within the scope of delegated responsibilities.

  • Support Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering and Manufacturing with mechanical expertise.

  • Own hardware bills of materials, component availability and technical documentation, keeping records accurate and current.

  • Coordinate technical orders and manage hardware inventory and development materials incl. in-house workshop management.

  • Work with Procurement, Manufacturing and suppliers to ensure hardware is available when development milestones require it.

  • Prepare hardware procurement decisions in line with defined budgets and development needs.

  • Deliver hardware solutions on time and meet product quality and reliability goals.

  • Continuously improve the hardware architecture for robustness, maintainability and manufacturability, and support the technical development of future Drone Port generations.


What you bring to the team:

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience developing technical systems and designing hardware.

  • Strong CAD skills; familiarity with CATIA V5 is an advantage.

  • Experience building and testing mechanical and electronic and l prototypes.

  • Experience leading a small, cross-functional sub-team or workstream, providing technical direction and taking ownership of outcomes.

  • Experience industrialising prototypes and transitioning them into series production.

  • Experience working with bills of materials, component management and suppliers.

  • A structured, self-directed and solution-oriented approach to work.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Knowledge of German is an advantage.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
At Ankar, we’re building AI to transform industrial R&D.

From understanding the technology landscape and identifying new invention opportunities to accelerating R&D and bringing products to market, we're inventing how innovation happens.

We work with some of the world's leading enterprises across industries, helping them unlock the value of their knowledge, experts, technical expertise, inventions, and turn ideas into real-world impact. We're the builders of the new age of industrial innovation.

Join us at a unique moment of scale:

  • We've raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the founders of Hugging Face, CEO of Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We're already working with the world's most innovative companies including Fortune 500 companies such as L'Oréal.

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We're just getting started.

We're growing rapidly, and looking for exceptional people to help us build what comes next.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist at Ankar, you'll help chart and build the art of the possible in enterprise R&D. You'll work on the frontlines with some of the world's leading enterprises, tackling their most important innovation challenges and bringing together technology, product and business to deliver real world outcomes.

Your mission is to discover where Ankar can create extraordinary value for our customers, and make that value a reality.

You'll immerse yourself in complex organisations, develop a deep understanding of their people, science, priorities and challenges, and uncover opportunities others might miss.

You'll bring curiosity, product intuition, commercial instinct and the ability to connect with people at every level of an organisation, helping them challenge established ways of working, imagine what's possible, and turn that ambition into action.

This isn't a traditional consulting, customer success or technical implementation role. You'll be part strategist, part operator, part product thinker and part builder. You'll need to be equally comfortable working with end users to understand their day-to-day challenges, shaping a proposition with senior executives, and collaborating with engineers to build something that doesn't yet exist.

You'll own outcomes, not just deliverables. From shaping an initial pilot to driving adoption, demonstrating impact and identifying opportunities to expand, you'll play a critical role in building Ankar's most important customer partnerships.

What You'll Do

Discover and unlock customer value

  • Immerse yourself in customers' businesses, workflows and strategic priorities to identify their most important problems and opportunities.

  • Connect the dots between customer needs, technology capabilities and commercial opportunities to define where Ankar can deliver the greatest impact.

  • Work with stakeholders from hands-on SMEs to senior executives, challenging assumptions and helping customers reimagine what's possible while building excellent rapport and passion for innovation to enable the work that’s needed.

Own deployments and drive impact

  • Lead customer engagements from early discovery and pilot scoping through deployment, adoption and expansion.

  • Translate ambitious, often ambiguous objectives into actionable plans, bringing together customers, engineers, product teams and commercial colleagues to deliver results.

  • Get hands-on with the product, data and customer workflows to solve problems, prototype solutions and unblock progress.

  • Define and demonstrate success through measurable customer outcomes, holding the vision of what’s genuinely valuable to the organisation beyond explicit deliverables.

Build strategic customer partnerships

  • Develop trusted relationships across complex enterprise organisations, from end users to executive sponsors.

  • Identify new use cases, stakeholders and opportunities to deepen the impact of Ankar's technology.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to shape account strategy, build compelling business cases and turn successful deployments into broader enterprise partnerships.

  • Communicate complex ideas and results clearly, building conviction and momentum at every level of the organisation.

Help shape the product and how we scale

  • Act as a critical bridge between our customers and our product and engineering teams, translating real-world challenges into product insights and opportunities.

  • Identify patterns across deployments that can inform our product roadmap, new capabilities and future market opportunities.

  • Develop repeatable approaches, tools and ways of working that help us deliver extraordinary customer outcomes at scale.

  • Help shape the deployment function itself as Ankar grows.

What We're Looking For

Above all, we're looking for exceptional problem solvers with the curiosity, creativity, judgment and drive to make things happen.

You might come from technology, consulting, engineering, product, strategy or an entirely different background. What matters most is how you think, learn and operate.

We value:

  • Intellectual curiosity and analytical rigour. A love for getting to the bottom of complex problems, asking better questions and finding connections others miss.

  • Value oriented instincts where you naturally look for opportunities to create value, understand what matters to a business, and can connect technical possibilities to meaningful commercial outcomes.

  • Product intuition and technical fluency - excited by technology, comfortable getting hands-on with software and data, and able to work effectively with engineers. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be eager and able to learn.

  • Ownership and resourcefulness. A tendency to thrive in ambiguity, take initiative and find ways forward even when there's no established playbook.

  • Strong communication and empathy. You build trust with people from very different backgrounds, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and can influence and bring people along without formal authority.

  • Adaptability and low ego - you’ll join a team that is willing to roll up their sleeves at any time and task. We index on value, and care more about outcomes than credit.

  • A bias for action. You combine big-picture thinking with the willingness and ability to execute.

Bonus points:

  • Experience working with enterprise software, AI, data or complex technical products, particularly in customer-facing roles.

  • Founding experience, or experience building a new product or business.

  • Experience in R&D-intensive industries such as automotive, semiconductors, advanced materials, chemicals, energy, aerospace or industrial manufacturing, including exposure to complex innovation and product development workflows.

  • Familiarity with technical information sources such as scientific literature, patents, experimental results, specifications and research documentation.

  • Hands-on experience prototyping, investigating technical problems or analysing data using Python, SQL, APIs or low-code tools.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.

The role involves travel, working closely with customers across the US and Europe.

Why Ankar?

You'll join a small, ambitious team at a pivotal moment in Ankar's growth, working at the frontier of AI and enterprise industrial R&D.

You'll help shape not just how our technology is deployed, but how some of the world's most innovative companies work.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with some of the world's leading companies, tackle genuinely complex problems and see the impact of your work firsthand.

You'll have real ownership from day one, a direct influence on the product we're building, and the opportunity to help define how Ankar works with customers as we scale globally.

If this sounds like you - sign up for the mission.

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As our Founding Account Executive, you will own go-to-market execution as the first dedicated sales hire, working directly alongside the CEO. We are moving fast and demand is accelerating. Founder-led sales has taken us this far, and now it is time to expand the commercial engine. That is where you come in. You will own the day-to-day execution of the full sales cycle and build the playbook as you go, working directly with the CEO on strategy, pricing, and positioning. Early on this is a true partnership: the founder is in the room with you on the key deals, and as you build the motion you take more and more of it end to end. You are the player-coach of our sales team, and you play both parts at once: on the field closing deals yourself now, and building and coaching the team that closes the next hundred.

This role is strategy and execution in one. You will help set commercial direction, then close deals personally until there is enough revenue to justify a team beneath you. Expect heavy customer time: site visits, pilot scoping, and direct relationships with security operators and decision-makers. If you want a defined playbook handed to you, this is not the role. If you want to write it, this is.

What You'll Work On

  • Full-cycle sales: source, qualify, run discovery and demos, negotiate, and close customers.

    • Enterprise B2B: win and grow commercial customers across enterprise and industrial critical infrastructure, where cycles move faster and land-and-expand is the play.

    • Public sector and defence (B2G): run the longer government and defence cycles, including procurement, tenders, and framework agreements.

  • Pilots to contracts: scope, sell, and run paid pilots (POCs) that convert into long-term contracts.

  • Founder-led sales, transitioned: co-sell the key early deals with the CEO, then take them fully end to end as the playbook takes shape.

  • Pipeline and CRM: keep every opportunity clean and current, with follow-ups that never slip.

  • The playbook: capture what works, sharpen the ICP, and feed real customer signal back to product.

  • Forecasting: honest and ambitious pipeline.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for a hunter, not a coin-operated salesperson. You have carried a full-cycle B2B number and personally closed, not just generated pipeline. You are comfortable in a room with a head of security, a head of operations, a government procurement lead, and a technical engineer, and you can switch registers between them. You treat customers as relationships to earn, not deals to extract, because in critical infrastructure trust is the whole game. Above all, you want to own and build a commercial function, not run a quota inside someone else's playbook.

Your Background

  • 5+ years of full-cycle enterprise B2B sales, with a verifiable record of closing six-figure plus deals.

  • Proven at self-sourcing pipeline; you do not wait for inbound to save you.

  • AI-fluent and unmistakably human. You are proficient with AI tools and use them to research, draft, and move faster, but you stay fully plugged in: you use your own judgment, bring high EQ, read the room, and build real relationships.

  • Technically literate. You do not need to code, but you must credibly sell a genuinely technical product to sophisticated buyers.

  • Organised and self-directed on the unglamorous parts: follow-ups, CRM hygiene, and clean deal documentation.

  • High agency, high reliability, high ambition.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into government or defence (procurement, RFPs, framework agreements).

  • Background selling deeptech, hardware, security, robotics, computer vision, or complex enterprise software.

  • Experience with a subscription or recurring-revenue product.

  • An existing network of security operators, integrators, or buyers in DACH and UK.

  • German language proficiency.

  • Startup or early-stage experience, ideally as an early or founding sales hire. You are comfortable with ambiguity and no infrastructure.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

jobs.description:
IAM Staff Engineer

Location: London, Bristol or Edinburgh

Level: PL1

Team: Security

Contract: Permanent

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

 

You’ll be joining the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, which sits within the Cyber Security squad in the Kaluza technology community, working hand-in-hand with security engineering as well as with Kaluza’s architecture team and technical leaders across our software engineering community. Your initial focus will be on our product IAM space, covering authentication & authorisation services that ensure the appropriate accesses are permitted on the Kaluza retail platform, whether that’s human or machine. The role will broaden over time to encompass our enterprise IAM and PAM solutions which protect us as a business, enabling us to better align these two aspects of IAM in use across Kaluza.

 

With millions of customers across multiple geographic regions, we naturally invest significant effort into availability, performance, security and observability, and the teams pride themselves on their ability to maintain a balance between rapid development of new services, iterative quality & feature enhancements alongside being highly responsive in incidents.

What will I be doing?

 

  • Collaborate with technical, product leadership to help shape and continuously improve our IAM technical strategy and solutions architecture

  • Lead the team hands-on in resolving complex technical issues, evaluating technical options, designing services and scoping engineering work

  • Work with client engineering teams to help them understand our IAM architecture and how to get the most out of our platform

  • Take the lead on evolving our identity and access best practices across engineering, proactively helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

  • Use your deep understanding of the IAM domain to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza as well as client teams

  • Mentoring and coaching engineers within the IAM space, helping them balance risk with speed and quality

  • Continuously improve quality across reliability, observability, functional and non-functional testing as well as development processes and documentation

  • Horizon scanning for emerging technologies and approaches to IAM, enabling Kaluza to continue to evolve, keeping us ahead of adversaries as well as cost-effective

What you will bring

 

  • Good experience of both mentoring engineers as well as developer collaboration (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Developing, testing, deploying and maintaining quality SaaS APIs in AWS

  • Working with (and continuous improvement of use with) fundamental DevSecOps engineering elements such as CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure As Code, Kubernetes containerization and platform health alerting & monitoring

  • Application of basic modern identity & access management techniques and standards, such as OAuth2.0 or SAML2.0

  • Integrating an IdP into services to enable SSO and/or federated identity

  • Use of encrypted JWTs as part of an OIDC-compliant user authentication flow and/or creating policies in an RBAC and ABAC environment

  • Experience of applying AI to your own work as well as enabling others to safely build it into their development ways of working

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent solutions, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Experience of applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex domain/environment

  • Experience of being a senior subject matter expert in operational incidents

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

Leadership, quality & delivery

You’ll be…

  • Proficient at applying your technical and commercial knowledge to a risk based approach, taking the lead on assessing current and future technology and designs

  • A pragmatic decision-maker who takes into account the technical & commercial costs and consequences of those decisions

  • Skilled at identifying new or improved ways of working and driving efficiencies

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements within the platform to balance meeting information security and commercial goals

  • Accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, using a mixture of communications skills

  • Skilled in bringing alignment, clarity of thought and direction to information security, product and engineering challenges

  • Able to establish a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and champion alignment to that vision across multiple teams.

  • Experienced in fostering a culture of learning and improvement, challenging engineering leadership to better support this

 

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

jobs.title: Defense Success Manager, France
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints, including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.


Nice to have

  • Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Account Executive - Enterprise I Paris
jobs.description:
About us

Procurement is overdue for a reset. For years, procurement and accounting teams have been stuck on legacy platforms that are now trying to bolt AI onto decades-old architecture. The rest of the enterprise tech stack is speeding companies up, and procurement is still slowing them down.

Pivot is the AI-native intake-to-pay platform built to change that. It’s the procurement platform people across the business actually use, so adoption sticks, cycle times drop, and finance sees spend before it’s committed, not after. And because Pivot touches every team in a purchase, accounting teams can finally fully automate their boring tasks.

The adventure started mid-2023 with three founders, former C-levels from fintech unicorns (Qonto, Swile, and Nuxeo).

We’ve built a team of 70 operating across 25+ countries. Backed by $70M from tier-1 investors and trusted by DoorDash, Lemonade, Wolt and Flix, we’ve just moved into the enterprise, and we’re only getting started.


We're looking for smart, execution-driven people who care about building something exceptional.

Your role

As an Account Executive - Enterprise, you will own the full sales cycle for our most strategic accounts on the French and Belgium market. You will target large, complex organisations with multiple stakeholders, navigate sophisticated procurement and legal processes, and close high-value, long-term deals that define Pivot's enterprise footprint in EMEA.

You will join our Sales team, which currently includes a VP of Revenue, Account Executives, a Pre-Sales Engineer, and a BDR team. You will report directly to VP of Revenue.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from first contact through close, managing procurement, legal, IT, and C-suite stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan targeting strategic enterprise accounts across your defined region, in close coordination with the BDR team. Willing to open doors by your own methods too.

  • Build and deliver compelling business cases, executive-level presentations, and tailored demos that articulate Pivot's value at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure commercial agreements, and ensure favourable terms for both Pivot and clients, building win-win partnerships designed to last.

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts, surfacing upsell and cross-sell potential to grow revenue and deepen relationships.

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline: own your forecast with accuracy on a monthly and quarterly basis, and manage CRM hygiene in HubSpot.

  • Collaborate internally:

    • Work closely with the BDR team, providing direction, feedback, and mentorship to maximise the quality and volume of enterprise pipeline.

    • Partner with Pre-Sales to manage technical evaluations, RFPs, and InfoSec requirements during complex sales cycles.

    • Coordinate with the Operations team to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term client satisfaction post-close.

Your sales mindset

  • You are a master of enterprise sales cycles: multi-threaded stakeholder management and driving consensus across large, complex organisations come naturally to you.

  • You are a strategic thinker who approaches your territory like a business: mapping white space, prioritising high-potential accounts, and building plans to convert them methodically over time.

  • You are confident and credible at C-suite level, able to engage procurement directors and CFOs.

  • You are resilient and persistent: long sales cycles don't discourage you. You manage momentum, keep deals alive, and know how to re-engage accounts that have gone quiet.

This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers.

 

The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

You'll own Core Engagement: a player's life with Midnite after they've made their first deposit, and every point where friction could cost us a good customer. Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

  • A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

  • Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

  • A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

  • A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

Team

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life.

We are now an international team of 100+ people with 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Data is becoming increasingly central to how we build the product, understand our users and make decisions. We are looking for a Head of Data to own the function end to end and build the foundations required for the next stage of BeReal's growth.

 

Role

You will lead a team of Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts, reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership role. BeReal deliberately operates with small, strong teams, and we are looking for someone who can define the direction while still going deep technically: reviewing architecture and data models, investigating quality issues, challenging pipelines, writing queries and building when necessary.

You should be the kind of leader who could design a modern data platform from scratch, scale it as the company grows, and make sure the people using it can trust what comes out of it.

 

What you'll own

  • Build and evolve the data platform. Own BeReal's data architecture end to end: ingestion, storage, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability and access. Build a platform that is simple, scalable, reliable and cost-efficient as both traffic and the number of data consumers grow.

  • Make data trustworthy. Raise the standard of data quality across the company through clear sources of truth, ownership, testing, monitoring, lineage and consistent metric definitions. Identify inconsistencies proactively and build systems that prevent them from recurring.

  • Data modeling and foundations. Define how our core entities, events and business concepts are represented across the warehouse. Build models that are reliable, understandable and maintainable as the product evolves.

  • Decisions, not dashboards. Turn large, complex user-level datasets into clear insights and recommendations that Product, Growth and leadership can act on. Help teams distinguish meaningful signals from noise and focus on the questions that matter.

  • Product analytics and experimentation. Own the methodology around instrumentation, Amplitude usage, event tracking, metric design and A/B testing. Ensure experiments are designed and interpreted rigorously and that product decisions are grounded in reliable data.

  • Make data self-service. Give Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership the tools and models they need to answer most questions independently, without creating a dependency on the Data team for every request.

  • AI-powered data access. Build or integrate practical ways for employees to interact with company data through AI (agents, bots, natural-language analytics and automated workflows) while maintaining strong standards around accuracy, permissions and governance.

  • Stakeholder management and prioritisation. Serve as the primary data partner to C-level executives and teams across Product, Growth and Engineering. Understand their needs, challenge requests when necessary, arbitrate between competing priorities and translate them into a coherent, high-impact data roadmap.

  • Technical leadership. Set strong engineering and analytics standards across the function. Review architecture, pipelines, models and queries, challenge technical choices and remain close enough to the work to intervene directly when needed.

  • Build the team. Lead, mentor and hire across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering and Data Analytics. Establish clear ownership, develop the people in the team and raise the technical and analytical bar.

     

Our Data Stack

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Spanner.

  • Orchestration & transformation: Airflow, dbt.

  • Product analytics: Amplitude.

  • Visualisation & analytics: Hex, Tableau, internal tools.

This is our current stack, not a constraint. You will have significant latitude to simplify, rationalise and evolve it when there is a strong reason to do so.

 

Profile

  • 8+ years in data, with deep roots in Data or Analytics Engineering, or data architecture.

  • A hands-on builder: you’ve designed, built and run modern data platforms, ideally from scratch, and know how architecture evolves with scale.

  • Strong across the stack (warehousing, ingestion, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability), with strong SQL and enough depth to challenge production pipelines and models.

  • Deep data quality expertise: testing, monitoring, lineage, ownership and source-of-truth design.

  • Experience with high-volume, user-level data and with building self-service analytics for non-data teams.

  • Solid in experimentation and A/B testing. Mobile experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Expansion lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

We are scaling fast and investing heavily in expanding our international footprint. Now, we are looking for an Expansion Lead to help us grow our presence across Europe.

About the role:

As Expansion Lead, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez, to drive Upvest's expansion into new markets and scale our presence in existing ones. You will own the end-to-end process of evaluating, planning and executing market entry - from market sizing and regulatory assessment to go-to-market execution and post-launch optimisation. You will run expansion as a cross-functional programme, working day to day with commercial, product and engineering, legal/compliance and operations, with direct exposure to senior leadership and to clients in each new market. This is a high-impact, highly visible role.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the international expansion strategy: Evaluate and prioritise new markets, then own the business case and roadmap for your countries, grounded in market sizing, competitive dynamics and regulatory feasibility

  • Lead expansion programmes end-to-end: Own each market entry as a programme, from the first regulatory application through to launch and beyond. You are accountable for the overarching project and you keep the cross-functional work running smoothly by collaborating closely with legal/compliance, product and engineering, and operations every step of the way.

  • Engage clients and prospects: Work with sales and partnerships to understand B2B client needs in your target market, validate demand, shape the proposition and support the onboarding of launch clients

  • Build external relationships: Engage with regulators, partners and industry bodies to unlock and de-risk expansion opportunities

  • Own cross-functional alignment: Align senior leadership and other departments on expansion priorities, timelines and resourcing

  • Track and report on expansion progress: Develop and own KPIs/OKRs for expansion initiatives and report progress to leadership and the board

  • Support fundraising and investor narrative: Contribute country and market insights to investor updates and board materials

What you bring:

  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in top-tier consulting, investment banking/private equity, or a high-growth scale-up, with direct exposure to market entry, GTM strategy or international expansion

  • You have hands-on experience in launching a product or business in a new European market, ideally in fintech, payments or capital markets

  • You have regulatory & financial literacy with a strong understanding of how regulation shapes market entry for a regulated financial business. You are comfortable engaging directly with regulators and compliance teams

  • You have a strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional programmes end-to-end, from scoping and sequencing to delivery across multiple stakeholders. You are comfortable in taking decisions and show true ownership

  • You have demonstrated strong leadership and communication skills, effectively engaging internal and external stakeholders to drive change

  • You are analytical & show commercial acumen: You are structured and numbers-driven, comfortable building business cases, market sizing and competitive analysis, and working with budgets and repeatable launch playbooks

  • You enjoy building relationships with clients/partners and have experience working with them collaboratively to solve problems and achieve shared goals

  • You are AI-native - you use AI tools proactively in your day-to-day work (synthesis, reporting, research) and are always looking for smarter, faster ways of working

  • Location: Berlin-based. German and English are must-have. It’s great if you speak additional European languages relevant to Upvest's target expansion markets

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Are you ready to be part of a bold entrepreneurial journey and help shape the future of finance? At Taurus, we're building the next-generation digital asset infrastructure, and we might just have the perfect opportunity for you.

jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers bilingue allemand H/F
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 
 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme.

 

Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de sa gestion comptable et financière.

 

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients et traites leurs demandes dans ces deux langues, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, en lien avec nos équipes internes. Tu contribues ainsi à leur offrir une expérience de support claire, réactive et adaptée à leurs besoins.

 

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

 

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou une solution à ton interlocuteur ou, quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.

 

Tu prends en charge les demandes des clients en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et transmets les éléments utiles aux équipes internes. Tu assures le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution et veilles à communiquer de manière claire à chaque étape.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

 

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu te familiarises avec les besoins des clients, notamment en Allemagne, et commences à traiter leurs demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

4 à 6 mois :

 

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes de ton portefeuille client.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne : tu analyses la situation, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches une solution adaptée.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes en français, formalises les éléments utiles à l’investigation et assures le suivi des demandes escaladées.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes produit des retours construits sur leurs besoins et les difficultés rencontrées.

 

Et ensuite... :

 

  • Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration

  • Tu prends le contrôle et mènes au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser

 

Profil recherché

 

  • Tu es bilingue allemand / français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Tu peux accompagner les clients et traiter leurs demandes dans les deux langues, et collaborer au quotidien en français avec les équipes internes.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets parfois techniques ou financiers de façon claire, faire preuve d’écoute et adapter ta communication à ton interlocuteur.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour investiguer une demande, en assurer le suivi et solliciter les bonnes équipes lorsque c’est nécessaire.

  • Expérience de plusieurs années au sein d’une “néo-banque”, d’une banque en ligne ou d’une banque traditionnelle.

  • Excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Expérience précédente en support B2B requise.

  • À l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

  • Disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus avec notamment la connaissance des produits des Fintech actuelles du marché.

 

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacements à Paris au sein de nos locaux par mois (frais pris en charge).

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

- Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Recruiter (30 min)

- Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert - Responsable de l’équipe (1h)

- Dernier échange visio avec Nathan Robinet - Senior Team Lead Customer Support - Financial Services (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
