jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Sales Benelux & Nordics
jobs.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President in EMEA to own and lead our Benelux and Nordics business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across two hubs: Amsterdam and Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes both the Benelux and Nordics regions from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

 

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across Benelux and Nordics from day one

  • Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions and forecast calls with precision and consistency

  • Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

  • Own the Benelux and Nordics regional number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all two sub-regions

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to VP EMEA and leadership

  • Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

  • Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in the Benelux and Nordics regions

Hiring

  • Manage multiple open roles across Benelux and Nordics simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment, and closing

  • Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for Benelux and Nordics regions beyond Q1 and feed into H2 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across UKI, Nordics and Benelux

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits and customer EBCs

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Benelux and Nordics most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the Benelux and Nordics markets back to the VP EMEA and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

 

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across Benelux and Nordics

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

  • You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

  • You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention

     

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center and for some a dedicated CSM.

When you're not delivering customer trainings, you help the wider team stay useful year-round: you build standardized video trainings based on the most common questions coming out of our support center, and you're available to represent Rentman at customer events or trade shows in German-speaking markets.

What you'll do

  • Integrate Rentman knowledge with customer-centricity and commercial acumen to provide tailored training, in both German and English, that enhances customer usage, satisfaction, and professional services revenue.

  • Deliver at least 60% of your time as direct, standardized-but-tailored training to customers, one-on-one or in groups.

  • When you're not training customers, build standardized video trainings/webinars addressing the most common issues raised through our support center.

  • Represent Rentman at customer-facing events or trade shows in German-speaking markets when needed.

  • Always look for opportunities to expand and optimize our professional services and serve more customers in a standardized way.

  • Maintain top-level knowledge of Rentman's functionality and industry challenges to advise customers effectively, and keep this knowledge current.

  • Excel in administration and process efficiency to ensure internal processes (availability, booking, invoicing) run smoothly, and the customer journey is frictionless.

  • Adopt a customer-friendly attitude and deliver high-quality training to ensure an optimal customer experience.

What we are looking for

  • Native or very fluent in German, and fluent in English. You're equally comfortable running a training in either language.

  • You've worked inside the AV, production company, or event rental industry and know its workflows from the inside. This is what lets you speak credibly to customers about how they run their business, not just how the software works.

  • Familiarity with Rentman or similar equipment rental or event management software.

  • You're curious about how customers actually get their work done and where the tool could serve them better.

  • You take ownership of your pipeline and your numbers.

  • You communicate clearly, both with customers and internally.

  • You keep your training administration, scheduling, and invoicing organized so the customer journey stays frictionless.

  • You can join us in the Utrecht office as this is a hybrid role.

Nice to haves

  • Experience training or onboarding customers on a SaaS platform.

  • Exposure to more than one segment, such as dry hire, staging, broadcast, or corporate AV.

  • An existing network in the German/DACH AV and event industry.

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30-45 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins)

  • A take-home assignment (max 120 mins)

  • Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)

Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:
AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn,Luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

The Role

This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You’ll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won’t be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you’ll be a credible partner in those conversations.

The profile we’re hiring is a technical account manager. You’ve worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can work credibly with everyone from a CxO to a Developer.

What the role is

  • An early seat. You’re helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence this team figures out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you

  • A technical customer-facing role. You’ll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they’re building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it’s needed

  • A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences

What the role is not

  • A traditional post-sales role. You’re measured on revenue, not health scores

  • An on-call support function. You’re not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You’re growing accounts

  • A technical delivery role. You’re not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people

  • A fully built motion. Much of this is still being built. If you spot gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook, you help build them

  • A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → self. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. “this is my job”

 

What You’ll Work On:

  • Build Modal’s account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business

  • Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts

  • Grow an account’s first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform

  • Get fluent enough in Modal to engage confidently with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product

  • Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap

  • Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and find expansion opportunities

 

You May Be a Fit If:

  • You’ve owned a revenue target or supported one in a highly technical, consumption business.

  • You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.

  • You’re hands on building with AI tools, not just consuming workflows that were built for you.

  • You treat your book of business and your projects as your own. You’re highly organized, bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work, and you’re comfortable taking action without waiting for direction.

  • You’d rather start something today than pick it up tomorrow. You move fast, take the learnings, and iterate on them.

  • You’re low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you’d rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

If you don’t match every point above but the role sounds like yours, we’d still like to hear from you.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or similar type role

  • Certification as an engineer (ex. Computer Science Degree, Professional Bootcamps)

  • Early GTM hire experience at a fast-growing startup

  • You’ve sat close to GPU spend, model training, or inference workloads

Compensation: $230K – $350K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Engineer II - EngEx AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer II - EngEx & AI Engineer

● Location: UK Hybrid

● Level: TL1

● Team: Engineering Experience & AI Foundations

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll join the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation.

As a Senior II Engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for our Internal AI Engineering Platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll design and implement the infrastructure, from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows, and use your influence across teams to make it the way Kaluza builds software. In 2027, our goal is org wide adoption of KASF across engineering, and you'll be a technical owner of getting there safely, securely and with measurable impact on quality and velocity.

  • Technical Direction & Architecture: Drive the architecture and technical roadmap for our EngEx & AI Platform Foundations team, including the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC), the AI governance layer (MCP and LLM gateways), and shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. Shape and document build-vs-buy decisions and balance fast-moving vendor capabilities against long-term platform stability.

  • Hands-On Delivery: Stay close to the implementation. Design, build and ship core platform components, set the engineering bar through your own code, and prototype new approaches to prove them before the team scales them.


  • Agentic SDLC (KASF) Adoption: Drive KASF from early adoption to all engineering teams during 2027. Oversee creation and evolution of reference architectures, standards and adoption playbooks, work with engineering leaders to embed KASF in how teams plan, build, review and ship, and use feedback and metrics to remove blockers.

  • AI Tooling Evaluation & Deployment: Lead structured, time-boxed trials of emerging engineering tools with clear success criteria and go/no-go recommendations. Keep Kaluza at the forefront of the AI space while retiring tools that don't earn their place.

  • Governance, Security & Risk: Act as the technical authority on AI risk for engineering. Work with Security, Legal and Data Protection to design approval processes and guardrails (data leakage, prompt injection, model access) that protect the business without slowing innovation.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Cost Optimisation: Partner with Finance and Security to keep AI usage secure and cost-efficient at scale, including guardrails and unit economics for model spend.

  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical standard of the team and the wider engineering community. Influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and build a network of AI champions in engineering teams. Pragmatic and open-minded and able to see things from different perspectives with both technical and non-technical cohorts.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Technical Leadership Experience: A substantial engineering background, with a track record of leading technical direction on platform, infrastructure or developer-experience work, and still hands-on in the code.

  • Production-Grade AI Implementation: Experience building and running production systems, ideally including LLM-based or agentic systems, and a deep interest in the "LLM-ops" lifecycle beyond chat interfaces, including evaluation, observability and reliability. Ideally experience across multiple model providers and multi-agent systems.

  • Systems Thinker: Strong distributed systems foundations and the judgement to integrate third-party AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI and others) without compromising reliability or latency.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance First: You understand AI risks such as data leakage and prompt injection, and can design guardrails and approval processes that protect the business without slowing it down.

  • Data-Informed: You define success measures up front, automate the metrics AI-generated code volume, PR velocity, adoption), and change course when the data says so.

  • Influence & Communication: You can bring senior stakeholders and sceptical teams with you, and translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs and shared best practice.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity & Judgement: The AI landscape changes weekly. You enjoy trialling new tools, and you have the judgement to pivot, or to say no, when a better option emerges.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

💊 Benefits

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

  • Gym membership (Gymlib)

  • Free books & learning material

Compensation: €85K – €100K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries.


How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build.


This is what you'll do

Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work.

  • Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in.

  • Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team.

  • Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time.

  • Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next. Bring design thinking to the table and help shape where the brand goes next, together with marketing, sales and product.

  • Win people over. Present your ideas to colleagues and leadership, and handle feedback from many stakeholders without losing the idea.

  • Use AI for creative exploration and enhance your workflow and spend your time on making the work exceptional.

This is what you'll need

  • 5+ years in visual, digital or brand design.

  • A portfolio that shows strong creative ideas and visual systems, not just single pieces. B2B work isn't required. Great work is.

  • A strong eye for digital: web design, layout, typography and detail.

  • Interest in product design and design thinking.

  • Mastery of Figma and Adobe CC. Motion skills (After Effects or similar) are a plus.Experience with Framer is a big plus as well

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools, and the curiosity to keep finding new ways to work better.

  • The ambition to grow the brand with us, and the confidence to explain your choices to a fellow designer and to a CEO.

Please note: this is not an art director or brand director role, or a role for a 3D, photography, video production or motion-only specialist.


What you'll get

At Dyflexis, you'll be part of an ambitious, energetic, and customer-focused team. We offer:

  • Fixed salary up to €6,000 gross per month based on a 40-hour week (experience based).

  • A MacBook Pro to do your best design work.

  • Personal development budget to level up your skills.

  • 25 vacation days plus your birthday off in exchange for cake.

  • An in-house chef surprising you daily with fresh lunch.

  • The best parties, drinks and trips (Winter sports, Ibiza and more).

  • Membership at ARJ Training boxing gym (home of champion Tarik and Levi Rigters).

  • Solid pension plan and 8% holiday allowance.

  • Buy or sell vacation days, you decide.

  • Travel allowance and WFH compensation.

  • Friday chair massages to kick off your weekend.

Apply now

Ready to take the Dyflexis brand and website to the next level? Hit apply with your CV and a portfolio of your work. No cover letter needed, we'll ask a few questions and get back to you quickly.

About us – in brief

Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.

Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.

We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them.

  • Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers.

  • Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks.

  • Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts.

  • Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again.

  • Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team.

  • Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment.

  • Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation.

  • Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates.

  • Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo.

  • Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site.

 

This Role Is For You If

  • You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome.

  • You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer.

  • You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself.

  • You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute.

 

This Role Is NOT

  • A people management role away from the code

  • A program or project management role

  • A pilot position or vehicle operator role

  • Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly)

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability

  • Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-program through design and delivery

  • Experience building and deploying software for unmanned systems (UAS, USVs, or UUVs), including C2 or onboard autonomy

  • Experience working directly with government or military customers to turn mission needs into technical requirements

  • Experience supporting live exercises, test events, or field deployments

  • Experience shipping work as part of larger releases that combine contributions from several teams

  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++)

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: NAT, DNS/mDNS, UDP/TCP protocols, multicast, and firewall configuration

  • Experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting

  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with U.S. government and military customers, vendors, and internal engineering teams

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestically and internationally, including to remote or restricted-access locations

  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance or higher

  • Prior defense, intelligence community, or aerospace software experience, especially with the U.S. Navy

  • Experience integrating C2 or autonomy software onto third-party vehicles

  • Familiarity with unmanned systems and C2 interoperability standards (UMAA, MAVLink, STANAG 4586, OMS, UCI, or A-GRA)

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands.

 

Language

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Reporting to the Associate Director, RCM - Aging, the Manager, Billing will lead a high-performing billing team focused on driving clean claims through the accurate and timely execution of the billing cycle. This full-time, remote role is part of the RCM - Aging team and plays a critical role in maximizing clean claim submission rates and collaborating cross-functionally to proactively resolve billing challenges before they escalate. For this role, occasional travel may be required for company or team events.

What you’ll do:

  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Billing Specialists and Sr Billing Specialists, responsible for day-to-day charge entry, claim creation, and timely submission.

  • Process Optimization & Scale: Identify operational bottlenecks and trends. Use data and analytics to prioritize work, design process changes, execute change management, and optimize existing workflows for continued growth and scalability.

  • Strategic Planning & Roadmap Alignment: Strategize with Operations leadership to marry staffing plans with technology roadmaps to streamline the insurance process, and support forecasting and resource planning to ensure the team is appropriately resourced.

  • Clean Claims Execution: Manage the billing workflow to drive a high clean claim rate, ensuring electronic claims are accurately formatted, audited, and successfully submitted within established timelines.

  • Proactive Issue Resolution: Work closely with the broader Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team to proactively identify and resolve front-end billing issues, preventing rejections and denials before they become escalations.

  • Payer Implementation & Revenue Integrity: Partner closely with the Revenue Integrity (RI) and Payer Implementations teams to ensure billing systems and workflows are properly configured for success prior to submitting claims for new payers.

  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of coaching and developing billing team members.

  • Proven experience navigating complex or unique healthcare billing scenarios (e.g., custom employer plans, carved-out mental health benefits, or multi-payer coordination).

  • Deep knowledge of medical billing standards, EDI transaction sets (837/835), CPT/HCPCS coding rules, and HIPAA compliance.

  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in billing software reporting and Excel data analysis to monitor submission metrics and SLAs.

  • Relentlessly organized with meticulous attention to detail and exceptional project management skills; ability to balance attention to detail with swift execution.

jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

At Superhuman, we're on a mission to redefine how people communicate and get work done with AI. We're hiring an experienced Staff Product Designer to join the Agents team in Berlin.

We're designing entirely new interaction patterns around how AI and humans work together through agents, through writing, from fixing your grammar to helping you schedule meetings. We're looking for someone to help us on that journey, help us build out new agents across Grammarly and Superhuman Go, and really define what these modern interaction patterns will be. You'd be involved end to end, partnering closely with our engineering and product teams, from Kyiv to Silicon Valley.

In This Role You Will:

  • Design zero to one agents. New writing and communication agents, built as AI-first products. A lot of the job is inventing interaction patterns that don't exist yet rather than applying ones that do.

  • Work with designers you'll learn from. The team spans San Francisco and Europe, with people who've come from some of the best product companies around. If you're looking for a design-focused environment with a lot of people to learn from, you'll get that here.

  • Pioneer new AI design workflows. The way we design is changing underneath us. We often start in code, refine in Figma, and ship frontend changes back into the codebase. We're defining that way of working as we go, and we want people who are excited to help build something that lets designers make whatever they can imagine.

  • Shape design strategy. Bring user insights, prototype ideas, and help build a longer-term view of where the Agents roadmap goes.

  • Lead and mentor. Raise the standard through critique, feedback, and working closely with less experienced designers.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Figma and Claude Design is expected. The following outlines the skills and experience that will set exceptional candidates apart for this role.

  • Extensive experience designing complex, scalable software. The kind of tool people sit inside all day, so productivity tools, creative or CAD software, developer tools. Most of that depth lives on desktop, so mobile isn't a primary focus for this role.

  • A genuine interest in AI technology, both conceptually and in practical workflows like reading, writing and translating, and you're already experimenting with AI-driven prototyping.

  • You care about language and writing. Words are the product here, so we want someone who also thinks about how a sentence works, what makes writing sound like a person, and how tone shifts depending on who you're talking to, not just the interface around the words.

  • Comfortable working with metrics and data-driven design decision-making.

  • Bonus is having worked directly in code and shipped PRs to production.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

  • Co-own service architecture, resilience, and scalability with respect to Domain-Driven Design principles

  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, anticipate risks, and mentor less experienced engineers

  • Drive continuous improvement, from fixing flaky CI to running post-mortems and propagating learnings across the team

  • Contribute to discovery, make technical decisions, monitor production performance, and steadily raise quality standards

  • Technical expertise: Strong backend engineering experience with exposure to large-scale web application architecture and real production constraints

  • Stack fluency: You don't need to know our exact stack, but you transfer fast and are comfortable with similar technologies

  • Quality-driven: You write tests, set up monitoring, handle incidents methodically, and do root cause analysis

  • Team player: You are comfortable working in squad teams with PMs, Designers, and other stacks, and you are fluent in English

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Our methodology, the Qonto Way: We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing. Quality drives the velocity our customers need

  • Autonomy: Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates

  • Continuous improvement: Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager

  • AI tooling: Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster

  • Our stack: Go and Ruby are our primary languages. Our platform runs on a Kubernetes cluster hosted on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our database of choice. We also use Kafka for event-driven architecture and ELK for logging and auditing, among many other tools and services


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the role

We’re looking for a Solutions Lead to help build Ramp’s solutions function for our international business, starting with the UK and Europe. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to prospects, customers and channel partners, shaping how we sell, implement and support complex solutions as the business grows.

You’ll connect technical discovery with implementation readiness, help resolve high-stakes customer challenges, enable partners, and build the demos, playbooks and technical expertise that make the wider team more effective.

You’ll combine technical depth, commercial judgement and a strong understanding of finance workflows to solve the most important problems yourself and build repeatable approaches so the business becomes less dependent on any one person. What you need

  • A strong track record, typically 5–7 years, in solutions consulting, sales engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting for complex B2B software, or in accounting or an in-house finance role with relevant systems and technical problem-solving experience.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model.   • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment.

This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.

You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success.

The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.

This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.

In this role you will

  • Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes.

  • Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the role

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. You will extend our existing TypeScript mobile test framework and help build quality in earlier, working alongside engineers in a collaborative team that wants to shift left. You’ll get coaching, mentoring and support from our Staff Quality Engineer.

What you’ll do

  • Hands-on functional, acceptance and planned, risk-based exploratory testing of our native iOS and Android apps

  • Be instrumental in the implementation of mobile tests that support the CI/CD pipeline for the software stacks and frameworks we support (TS, XCode, WebdriverIO)

  • Work with the Staff QE to ensure the rollout and socialisation of proactive quality information, plans and reports to project teams, enabling them to make better decisions around processes, solutions and releases

  • Advocate for, coach and educate project teams on the contextual use of testing techniques that allow us to embed shift-left and shift-right testing practices

  • Bring a quality lens to ideas before they’re built, working with engineers, product and design (e.g. Three Amigos)

  • Work comfortably in ambiguity: find gaps, chase down requirements and take initiative without being spoon-fed

  • Contribute to upcoming projects, including acceptance testing to support the backend re-architecture and our quality strategy refresh

  • Use AI tools to move faster and go broader, with appropriate guardrails to keep quality high

About You

  • Hands-on experience testing iOS and Android apps, and adding tests to an existing automation framework (we use TypeScript; familiarity helps and tool agnosticism is welcome)

  • A blend of manual and automated testing, with breadth across testing types (functional, acceptance and exploratory, with non-functional a bonus) and the judgement to know which to use when

  • You’ve owned testing and built things, such as a framework, automation or a test process your team adopted

  • Strong written and verbal communication (fluent English) and influencing skills, comfortable sharing test plans and reports and advising engineers, product owners and project managers

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with uncertainty, curious, and looks for gaps and negative cases

  • Pragmatic: you know what “good enough” looks like and help teams ship

  • Experience in exploratory testing and/or requirements discovery

  • Strong independent testing skills and opinions, and a curious but pragmatic view of AI

jobs.description:
At a Glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: Flexible hybrid, one to two days per week in office.

Employment type: Permanent

Salary: £60,000 - £70,000

Why this role exists: To give our Technology and Product teams a genuine strategic partner who shapes and owns the people strategy behind their goals, not someone who just runs HR process.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match. AI handles the heavy lifting, our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why Join Our People Team

● There's genuine room to bring your own ideas to the wider People Partner team: templates, calibration frameworks, how a restructure gets structured, and shape those alongside your peers rather than working them out alone in your own corner.

● We're growing, and a lot of the people strategy isn't fixed yet. You'll have a real say in shaping it, not just delivering against decisions someone else already made.

● You'll support Technology and Product, in a way that fits how we do things at Redgate.

About the Role

This isn't a role about running HR process. You'll operate as a genuine strategic partner to the Technology and Product leadership teams, helping shape, own, and deliver the people strategy that drives their goals and, in turn, Redgate's wider goals.

  • You'll sit inside the leadership team's regular rhythm, seeing the roadmap and trade-offs early enough to shape them, not just react once there's a people problem

  • Full ownership of the people strategy for Technology and Product: headcount plan, org design, succession, and retention, agreed directly with the functional exec

  • Real thought leadership beyond your own patch: spot patterns across functions (promotion criteria that don't hold up, gaps in how senior hires are onboarded) and bring them to the wider People Partner team

  • Coach and challenge leaders directly, including pushing back on a VP or exec when the data or your judgement says they've got it wrong

  • Find practical ways to bring AI into how the function and the People Partner team work, not as a bolt-on

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Solid experience as a strategic People Partner or HR Business Partner in a high-growth or fast-changing business, ideally tech or SaaS, partnering directly with product or engineering leadership

  • A commercial mindset: able to connect the business issue behind a people problem and the people issue behind a business problem, with a track record of turning that into commercial outcomes

  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and make decisions stick without relying on formal authority

  • Confident using people metrics (attrition, engagement, hiring velocity, time to fill) to diagnose what's really going on, not just report on it

  • Evidence of shaping how a People team works, not just delivering inside your own area, for example building a framework or fixing a broken process

What We Offer

● Salary range: £60,000 - £70,000

● Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office

● Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

● Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

● Private health insurance

Link to full benefits page here

What Happens Next?

● Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications, and every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

● You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

● Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

Le Poste

L'équipe est composée d'une Product Manager, un Engineering Manager 2 développeurs BACK PHP et 2 développeurs FRONT (Typescript / React). Intégrée au sein de la Squad MERCHANT, dédiée aux outils et services à destination de nos marchands partenaires, nous fonctionnons en Scrum avec des sprints de deux semaines et une livraison continue.

Voici les principales informations sur l'équipe :

  • L'amélioration continue et la capacité à délivrer une qualité toujours au rendez-vous sont des enjeux très forts au sein de cette équipe.

  • Au sein de la squad MERCHANT, nous développons et maintenons des APIs Backend utilisées par nos marchands pour interagir avec la plateforme de paiement Paygreen by Lemonway.

📌 Les missions principales

Contribuer au développement de notre offre produit

  • Participer au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur les APIs Backend PHP exposées aux marchands.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et les développeurs seniors pour s'assurer que les solutions développées répondent aux besoins des marchands et aux standards de la plateforme.

Participer à la gestion du legacy

  • Analyser et comprendre le code existant pour identifier les zones nécessitant une refonte ou une optimisation.

  • Contribuer aux chantiers de réduction de la dette technique en collaboration avec l'équipe.

  • Participer à la refactorisation du code selon les bonnes pratiques, sous la supervision de développeurs expérimentés.

Contribuer à la documentation et aux process

  • Rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire pour les APIs développées.

  • Appliquer les guidelines de développement de l'équipe et contribuer à leur amélioration.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'utilisation des pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser les contrôles qualité.

Améliorer la qualité du code

  • Participer aux revues de code et progresser grâce aux retours de l'équipe.

  • Contribuer à l'écriture de tests unitaires et d'intégration pour sécuriser les livraisons.
