jobs.title: Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

France's solution partner ecosystem is an important lever for Dust's growth. As Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners (France), you'll own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic. You'll turn those relationships into qualified opportunities and repeatable commercial motions, working closely with Dust's Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams.

This is a hands-on, commercially accountable role. You'll help assigned partners identify the right customer problems, shape clear joint propositions, and move opportunities forward. You'll enable partner teams to explain Dust and support customers effectively, drawing on Dust's technical and delivery teams where needed. Your focus is activation and follow-through for your assigned French solution partner portfolio, in coordination with colleagues who own strategic partner relationships and broader ecosystem programs.

Key Responsibilities

Grow and activate the partner portfolio

  • Own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners in France that are not yet strategic, including digital transformation and AI consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners

  • Agree on focused joint plans with each priority partner, including target accounts, customer problems, sellable offers, measurable outcomes, owners, and next steps

  • Identify promising new solution partner relationships and qualify them on customer access, strategic fit, delivery capability, and willingness to invest in a joint motion

  • Help partners turn their existing expertise and customer relationships into a clear path to working with Dust

Generate and progress partner-led opportunities

  • Work with partners and Dust Account Executives to identify, qualify, and advance partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities

  • Map stakeholders and account entry points, clarify the partner's role, and coordinate next steps across the customer, partner, and Dust teams

  • Support deal strategy, value articulation, and partner participation in sales cycles, escalating product, commercial, or delivery questions to the right teams

  • Maintain a reliable view of partner pipeline, deal progress, risks, and expected contribution in Dust's CRM and reporting processes

Enable partners to sell and support Dust

  • Run practical partner onboarding and enablement so partner teams can explain Dust, identify relevant use cases, and participate confidently in customer conversations

  • Coordinate product, sales, and deployment guidance with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner Delivery; help partners become increasingly self-sufficient without taking on delivery ownership

  • Share relevant customer stories, use cases, and sales materials, and identify gaps in the enablement partners need to move opportunities forward

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

Build a repeatable solution partner motion

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

  • Identify patterns in successful partner-led deals and feed practical recommendations into the broader Partnerships and GTM teams

  • Surface customer and partner feedback from the French market to inform positioning, offers, enablement, and go-to-market priorities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or commercial account management in B2B SaaS or a related technology business

  • A track record of creating measurable commercial outcomes through partners, such as qualified pipeline, co-sell opportunities, partner activation, or revenue

  • Strong understanding of the French B2B partner ecosystem, including consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners, with the ability to qualify them on customer access and fit

  • Fluent French and professional English, with the ability to lead partner and customer conversations in both languages

  • Commercial judgment and operating discipline: you can prioritize a partner portfolio, build actionable joint plans, manage a pipeline, and maintain clear follow-through

  • Confidence coordinating multi-party sales opportunities and aligning external partners with internal sales and technical teams

  • Strong communication and enablement skills: you can make a technical product understandable and help others present its value credibly

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership, raises risks early, and builds practical processes as the motion develops

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to use agents and AI tools to improve how you work

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with digital transformation agencies, AI consultancies, regional systems integrators, or implementation partners

  • Experience activating solution partners and progressing partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities in France

  • Familiarity with AI agents, enterprise software, SaaS integrations, or technology-enabled consulting and delivery

  • Existing relationships with relevant French solution partner firms

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct commercial impact: Your work will contribute to qualified pipeline, partner-led opportunities, and revenue in France

  • A focused growth mandate: Activate assigned new and existing French Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic, with clear prioritization and commercial accountability

  • Cross-functional ownership: Connect partners with the right Dust commercial, technical, and delivery teams to make joint opportunities actionable

  • Room to build: Help shape a repeatable way for partners to introduce, sell, and support Dust as the ecosystem grows

  • A fast-moving category: Work with a product and market that are evolving quickly, alongside a team that values customer outcomes, accountability, and practical execution

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Du willst Produkte nicht nur konzipieren, sondern sie selbst live bringen?

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du eigene Produkte und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Launch. jobs.title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on.

Who We Want

An experienced Data Engineer.
You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself.

Strong in SQL and dbt.
You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation.

At home in the Cloud.
You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine.

Reliability-minded.
You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you.

Curious about the business.
You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure dashboard builder.
You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from.

Pure pipeline plumber.
You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them.

Over-engineer.
You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it.

Remote-only operator.
You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office.

Our Data Stack

  • Warehouse: AWS Redshift
  • Ingestion: Airbyte, custom Python
  • Transformation: dbt
  • Orchestration: Dagster
  • Reverse ETL: Hightouch
  • BI: Metabase
  • Infrastructure & CI: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions

Your Day To Day

  • Own ingestion from our product database, Chargebee, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Amplitude and other tools, using Airbyte where it works and your own Python where it doesn't.
  • Design and build the dbt models that take raw data to gold tables, with clear layers, naming and documentation that the Business Analyst and the rest of the company can rely on.
  • Run orchestration in Dagster: schedules, dependencies, freshness checks and alerting, so a stalled sync gets noticed within hours.
  • Build data quality in: dbt tests, source checks and CI on every pull request.
  • Capture history where our source systems only keep the current state, so a question like "which plan was this customer on last March?" has an answer.
  • Run the warehouse: Redshift performance and cost, access management, and AWS infrastructure in Terraform.
  • Maintain the reverse ETL syncs (Hightouch) that send data back into HubSpot, Intercom and the other tools our teams work in.

Why People Choose Us

Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics

Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable

Real ownership. You own the data platform end to end, not one step of someone else's pipeline

Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup

Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Software Prototyping Engineer - N3XT (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the role:
N3XT’s software engineers write the code that makes a prototype useful: autonomy behaviours, sensor data processing, AI models running on the edge, and the interfaces to Quantum Systems’ platforms and to MOSAIC. Your software runs on real hardware in the field, often within weeks of the first idea, and you work next to the hardware and embedded engineers who build the system around it.

We are hiring at junior and senior level. Senior engineers own the software architecture of a prototype and develop the people around them. Junior engineers take ownership of well-defined components and grow quickly through work on real systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop prototype software for autonomy, perception, sensor fusion, signal processing and mission functions.

  • Deploy and optimise AI and computer vision models on edge compute such as NVIDIA Jetson, within real size, weight and power limits.

  • Integrate sensors and payloads in software: drivers, data pipelines, time synchronisation and calibration.

  • Connect prototypes to Quantum Systems platforms and to MOSAIC through clean interfaces: APIs, middleware and message protocols.

  • Build simulation, test and data-logging tools so that every field test produces usable data.

  • Join field tests and fix problems on site.

  • Write code that line engineering can take over: structured, tested and documented.

  • Senior level: define the software architecture of a prototype, make technology choices, review code and mentor junior engineers.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field.

  • Strong C++ and/or Python, and a Linux development environment.

  • Experience in at least one of our domains: Air, Land, Sea or Software.

  • Interest in software that runs on hardware, outside the data centre.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Business-fluent English. German is a strong advantage.

Strong adventage:

  • Defence experience, or a working understanding of how armed forces use unmanned systems and what is being built for them right now.

  • ROS 2, PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, DDS, GStreamer.

  • Processing radar, electronic warfare or signal intelligence data; software-defined radio (e.g. GNU Radio).

  • Model optimisation with CUDA or TensorRT.

  • Docker, CI/CD and automated testing for embedded targets.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. jobs.title: Shared Services Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records.

This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services.

Why this timing matters

We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it.

What makes this different

Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion.

What You'll Do

  • Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences.

  • Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting.

  • Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers.

  • Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files.

  • Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation.

  • Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth.

  • Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable.

  • Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement.

  • Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes.

  • Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers.

  • Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred.

The reality check

This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. _______________________________________________________________________

The Role

You will work closely with our Account Executives and customers to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, and to negotiate and close renewal contracts.

A successful Renewals Manager at Docker will be able to build strong relationships with customers and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They will have a deep understanding of our products and services, and be able to articulate the value that we provide to our customers. jobs.title: Global Programme Director - CRM
People & Workplace Manager
jobs.description:
About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

Davis is in a phase of strong acceleration. The team grows every month, our client base is widening and we are expanding in the US and in the Middle East. Our founders spend their days with developers, investors, partners and candidates, and every hour they lose to logistics is an hour taken from the company. Your job is to make sure that does not happen.

The role sits at the centre of the company and has two sides. On the people and workplace side, you work with our Chief of Staff and own the employee journey, our team rituals and our offices, in Paris and in the new ones we open abroad. On the executive side, you work directly with our co-founders, from their calendars to their board meetings. You are the first point of contact for the team and for everyone who walks through our door.

What you will be working on:

Own the employee journey

Owning the onboarding experience end to end, from equipment and access to the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one.

  • Handling offboarding with the same care, along with the HR admin that comes with each arrival and departure.

  • Being the first point of contact for the team's everyday questions and needs.

Build culture and community

  • Running and improving our team rituals, from team lunches and drinks to company gatherings.

  • Organising our offsites and our presence at industry events.

  • Creating moments that help people connect and celebrate progress, across offices and time zones.

  • Listening to the team and turning feedback into concrete improvements.

Shape our workplaces

  • Running our Paris office end to end, from vendors and supplies to welcoming the clients and investors who visit us.

  • Leading the opening of our new offices abroad over the coming months, from finding the right space to making it work for the team.

  • Managing workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and handling invoices and expense reports.

Support the founders

  • Owning the founders' complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics, and protecting their time for the work that moves Davis forward.

  • Preparing their key meetings with clients, investors and the board, and making sure every follow-up gets done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-growing startup.

  • You are fluent in French and in English.

  • You have warmth and empathy, and a genuine interest in helping people feel good and work better.

  • You anticipate needs before they are voiced, and once you start something, you see it through.

  • You are at ease switching from a travel booking to an office issue to a board meeting in the same morning.

  • You are rigorous with admin, and you have already handled invoices, expenses or onboarding.

  • You are very comfortable using AI, and you learn fast.

Nice to have

  • Experience opening or setting up an office, ideally abroad.

  • Experience in people operations in an international company.

  • Event organisation, from offsites and team events to trade shows.

  • Experience working directly with a CEO or founder.

  • Familiarity with modern finance and HR tools (accounting, payroll, applicant tracking).

  • An interest in real estate, architecture or AI.

Why Join Davis

  • Shape the Davis experience for every person who joins, at a moment the team grows every month.

  • Open our offices abroad, and build how Davis works across countries.

  • Work directly with the founders, in a seat that sees every part of the company.

  • Grow with the company, as the role expands with Davis.

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and a sports membership.

  • A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers, architects and real estate experts, backed by world-class VCs.

More About Davis

The Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today our team brings together technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA, architects and deep real estate expertise, and it grows every month. We are small with an extremely high bar, and we intend to keep it that way.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

About Bitstack

It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that invests spare change in bitcoin, to a crypto-native bank bringing a better way to save, spend, and grow money to our 300K+ users. We want to rebuild finance from the ground up to empower people to achieve financial freedom by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We’re a small, ambitious team of operators. We believe in moving fast, sweating the details, and creating products people truly love. At Bitstack, you’ll have the opportunity to shape not just our products, but the culture and practices of our entire organization. Bitstack is backed by YC, leading VCs like 13books Capital, Stillmark, Serena, and many more. We are building a product our users love and we are just getting started!

The Role

Bitstack runs dozens of interconnected backend services on Google Cloud. As the engineering team grows, we want every engineer to be able to test their changes end to end, quickly and independently, before they reach our shared environments.

As part of the Infrastructure team, you will build a local test environment for our backend engineers and QA. The goal is simple: anyone can start our backend services and their dependencies on their own machine with a single command, reproduce real business scenarios and test asynchronous flows end to end. You will own the project from the initial assessment through to company-wide adoption.

What You'll Be Doing

1. Assessment & Recommendation

  • Learn our stack (Go and Python services, Bazel, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP) and map how our services depend on each other.

  • Evaluate the test tooling and emulators already in our codebase, as well as the tools available on the market.

  • Recommend an approach, and record your tooling choices and trade-offs in a decision log.

2. Building the Local Environment

  • Start with a pilot cluster of interconnected services and get it running locally with a single command.

  • Solve the real problems as they come up: configuration and secrets, service-to-service authentication, cloud dependencies (Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, databases, caches) and async workers.

  • Extend coverage cluster by cluster until every backend service is included.

3. Scenarios, Data & Adoption

  • Build seed data and scripts so that any user state, limit or time-based event can be reproduced and reset on demand.

  • Work with backend engineers and QA as your first users, gather their feedback and fix what breaks.

  • Write documentation clear enough for a new engineer to get set up on their own, and support the team through the switchover.

By the end of the internship, you will turn your decision log into a recommendation report and hand over a tool the team will keep maintaining.

You will gain hands-on experience with a production-grade microservices architecture on Google Cloud, and see how a platform tool is designed, built and adopted by an engineering team. You will learn how infrastructure decisions are made and documented, and work closely with backend, QA and infrastructure engineers, with mentoring from a DevOps engineer throughout.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently in the final year of an engineering school or Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Computer Science or a related field, and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in early 2027.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and a working knowledge of Kubernetes.

  • Comfortable with Linux and scripting (shell, Python or similar).

  • Previous experience with a cloud provider, through an internship, a project or coursework. GCP is a plus.

  • Experience with Go, Bazel or Docker Compose is a plus, but not required.

  • Curious and autonomous: you like to understand how a system fits together before changing it.

  • Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly, in writing and to the engineers who will use what you build.

  • Fluent in English. French is a plus.

  • Based in Paris or happy to relocate for the internship. Exceptional candidates elsewhere in France who’d prefer to work remotely are welcome to apply too.

Perks & Benefits

💻 3 days in the office in Paris (Bourse) and 2 days working remotely

🕑 Flexible working hours

🏄Team activities and annual offsites

🍉 Swile meal vouchers

Diversity & Inclusion

We hire talented and passionate people from all kinds of backgrounds, we don’t care about your age or where you studied. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t match every bullet point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. What matters most is that you’re a builder at heart, you share our values, and you’re enthusiastic about our mission.

As Strategy Analyst, you will work directly alongside Alta Ares' Director of Strategy to support the company's most important strategic decisions from market positioning and competitive intelligence to fundraising preparation and institutional partnerships.

This is a high-exposure, high-output role. You will produce the analyses, frameworks, and documents that land on the CEO's desk and in front of investors and government partners. You will be expected to think rigorously, move fast, and communicate with clarity in a company where the stakes are real and the pace is unrelenting.

If you come from strategy consulting or a defence policy background and want to apply that rigour to one of Europe's most ambitious deeptech companies, this role is for you.

1. Strategic Analysis & Market Intelligence

  • Conduct in-depth analyses of defence markets, procurement trends, geopolitical dynamics, and competitive landscapes across Alta Ares' key geographies (Europe, US, UK, APAC)

  • Track and synthesise developments in defence policy, NATO priorities, EU defence funding mechanisms (EDF, EUDIS), and national defence budgets

  • Map competitive positioning across the global defence AI and autonomous systems ecosystem — Anduril, Palantir, Helsing, Shield AI, and emerging European players

  • Produce structured, actionable intelligence reports for the Director of Strategy and executive team

  • Monitor technology trends relevant to Alta Ares' product roadmap: AI/ML in defence, C-UAS, ISR, autonomous systems

2. Strategic Projects & Decision Support

  • Support the Director of Strategy on high-priority cross-functional projects: market entry analysis, partnership evaluation, product-market fit assessment, and build/buy/partner decisions

  • Build financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases to support strategic decisions

  • Prepare executive-level presentations and strategy documents for internal leadership, board meetings, and investor interactions

  • Conduct structured research and due diligence on potential partners, markets, and acquisition targets

  • Track OKRs and strategic initiative progress across the company on behalf of the Director of Strategy

3. Fundraising & Investor Support

  • Support the preparation of fundraising materials: investor decks, data room content, market sizing analyses, and competitive benchmarks

  • Conduct research on potential investors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and defence-focused VCs

  • Prepare briefing notes ahead of investor meetings and track follow-up commitments

  • Assist in responding to investor due diligence requests with structured, well-sourced analysis

4. Institutional & Partnership Intelligence

  • Research and map key institutional stakeholders across NATO, EU, and bilateral defence frameworks relevant to Alta Ares' commercial and policy agenda

  • Support the preparation of partnership proposals, MoU frameworks, and institutional briefing documents

  • Monitor defence innovation programmes, grant opportunities, and government procurement initiatives that Alta Ares could engage with

  • Prepare country and market entry briefs for new geographies under consideration

5. Internal Strategy Communication

  • Draft and format internal strategy documents, memos, and decision briefs with clarity and precision

  • Support the Director of Strategy in preparing All-Hands presentations, leadership offsites, and quarterly strategy reviews

  • Maintain organised knowledge bases and strategic reference documents in Notion

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, defence policy, or a related analytical role

  • Top-tier educational background: grande école (Sciences Po, HEC, Polytechnique, INSEAD) or equivalent international institution

  • Prior exposure to defence, aerospace, deep tech, or government-adjacent sectors is a strong plus

  • Experience producing executive-level deliverables under time pressure in a demanding environment

Skills & Qualities

  • Exceptional analytical rigour: you structure complex problems, identify the right frameworks, and reach clear conclusions

  • Outstanding written communication in English is mandatory: your memos, slides, and reports must be publication-ready

  • French fluency is mandatory: internal working language in Paris is French

  • Strong PowerPoint / Google Slides skills: you produce slides that are clear, well-structured, and visually sharp

  • Comfortable with financial modelling and quantitative analysis (Excel / Google Sheets)

  • Expert with Notion. Coding is a plus.

  • Fast learner: you get up to speed on new markets, technologies, and geopolitical contexts quickly and independently

  • Proactive and autonomous you don't wait to be told what to analyse next

  • Discreet and professional you will handle sensitive commercial, financial, and strategic information daily

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own our customer deployments end to end. Our system runs on-prem at industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, and military sites, integrated with the cameras, networks, and robots already in place. You survey the site, plan the deployment, install and integrate the system, tune it to the site's conditions, and hand it over to operators who will rely on it daily.

You are also the technical face of Laelaps on site. You work with security operators to understand how they actually work and where the bottlenecks are, align with their leadership on what success looks like, and translate what you learn into configuration, code, and product priorities. Early deployments you run alongside the founders; over time you own sites and accounts independently.

Expect roughly half your time at customer sites in Switzerland and Europe, and the rest in Zurich, turning field lessons into tooling and automation that make each deployment faster than the last. This is an engineering role with a customer in the room, not a support or services role.

What You'll Work On

  • Deployments end-to-end: site surveys, network and hardware planning, installation, camera and VMS integration, commissioning, validation, and handover.

  • On-prem infrastructure: install and manage our stack on edge hardware (NVIDIA DGX Spark, Jetson Thor class devices) inside customer networks, often air-gapped or heavily restricted.

  • Integrations: connect existing cameras, sensors, VMS platforms, and robots into one coordinated system, and write the glue code where no integration exists yet.

  • System tuning: calibrate detection and tracking to each site's terrain, lighting, and threat profile until the system performs in the field as it does in the demo.

  • Pilots to production: make POCs succeed technically, because pilots that work become contracts.

  • Customer understanding: sit with operators, interview stakeholders from the control room to the leadership floor, and map the real problems and bottlenecks behind the stated requirements.

  • Customer trust: train operators, respond fast when something breaks, and be the engineer customers ask for by name.

  • The deployment playbook: turn every hard-won lesson into runbooks, tooling, and automation that compound.

  • Product feedback: bring real field signal back to the core engineering team and shape the roadmap with it.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for an engineer who runs toward the messy parts, with the EQ to match the IQ. You are as comfortable in a server room or on a windswept perimeter as you are in a terminal, and just as comfortable in a conversation. You can spend a shift with a security operator and earn enough trust that they tell you what actually goes wrong at 3 a.m., then brief a head of security or a site director in their language, not yours. You listen more than you pitch, you read the room, and you switch registers between the guard house and the boardroom without breaking stride. You debug across the whole stack without ceremony: is it the hardware, the network, the driver, the model, or the config? Above all, you take personal ownership of the outcome: the deployment works because you made it work, and the customer trusts us because you earned it.

Your Background

  • 3+ years of relevant software, robotics, embedded systems, or systems integration experience.

  • A Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong Python and hands-on C++ experience. You can read, debug, and extend production code in both.

  • Experience deploying and operating software on-prem or at the edge (Docker required; GPU inference experience a strong plus).

  • Experience working with sensors and embedded systems, including device interfaces and communications protocols.

  • High EQ and experience working directly with end users or customers: you can uncover needs, work across stakeholders, and communicate technical issues clearly.

  • Composure in customer-facing technical sessions, including when systems fail and plans need to change.

  • Fluent German and/or French, and good English. Our sites and their operators run in German; the team runs in English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customer sites across Switzerland and Europe, with multi-day on-site stints.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich.

  • Citizenship of Switzerland, an EU/EFTA member state, or a NATO member state, and eligibility for security clearance where customer sites require it.

  • A valid category B driving license.

Nice to Have

  • Real networking competence: VLANs, firewalls, routing, VPNs, and debugging connectivity in networks you do not control.

  • Hands-on comfort with hardware: you have racked servers, flashed devices, crimped a cable, or built systems that touch the physical world. Checking cable connections at 2 a.m. at a client site is second nature while debugging an issue on a customer side.

  • Experience with cameras, VMS platforms (Milestone, Genetec, or similar), ONVIF/RTSP, or the physical security industry.

  • Computer vision or ML deployment experience, especially optimising inference on edge GPUs.

  • Robotics experience: ROS2 and Rviz2, robot integration, or fleet operations.

  • Experience in defence, government, or other regulated environments.

  • French, Italian, or another European language.

  • Startup experience, ideally somewhere you were handed a hard problem and a deadline instead of a spec.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

This may not be the right role for you if: 

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
